1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kathyamānamahaṃ tvayā ..
vidhiṃ śrāddhasya dharmajña tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यमानमहं त्वया ॥
विधिं श्राद्धस्य धर्मज्ञ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / O venerable one, I wish to hear related by you / the rule of the śrāddha, O knower of dharma; explain that to me as I ask.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vakṣyamāṇaguṇānviprānpūrvedyurupamantrayet ..
kartrā sametaistairbhāvyaṃ saṃyataiśca nimantritaiḥ .. 2 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
वक्ष्यमाणगुणान्विप्रान्पूर्वेद्युरुपमन्त्रयेत् ॥
कर्त्रा समेतैस्तैर्भाव्यं संयतैश्च निमन्त्रितैः ॥ 2 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the preceding day, one should invite brahmins endowed with the qualities to be described; / those invited should remain restrained together with the performer.

1.140.s:
śrāddhāhe prayataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
śuklavāsāḥ samabhyarcya nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam .. 3 ..
1.140.d:
श्राद्धाहे प्रयतः स्नातः स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः ॥
शुक्लवासाः समभ्यर्च्य नृवराहं जनार्दनम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.140.m: On the day of the śrāddha, purified, having bathed, having properly sipped water, very collected, / dressed in white garments, having worshipped Janārdana as the Man-Boar,

1.140.s:
āmaśrāddheṣu kāmyeṣu hutvā prathamapañcakam ..
(madhyamaṃ pañcakaṃ hutvā paśuśrāddheṣvasaṃśayam .. 4 ..
1.140.d:
आमश्राद्धेषु काम्येषु हुत्वा प्रथमपञ्चकम् ॥
(मध्यमं पञ्चकं हुत्वा पशुश्राद्धेष्वसंशयम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.140.m: having offered the first group of five in uncooked śrāddhas performed for desired objects / (having offered the middle group of five in animal śrāddhas, without doubt,

1.140.s:
amāvasyāsu sarvāsu hutvā cottamapañcakam ..)
hutvā ca pañcakānetānaṣṭakātritayaṃ kramāt .. 5 ..
1.140.d:
अमावस्यासु सर्वासु हुत्वा चोत्तमपञ्चकम् ॥)
हुत्वा च पञ्चकानेतानष्टकात्रितयं क्रमात् ॥ 5 ॥
1.140.m: and having offered the highest group of five on all new-moon days), / and having offered these groups of five in order on the triad of Aṣṭakās,

1.140.s:
anvaṣṭakāsu ca tathā bhojayetprayato dvijān ..
dvau divye prāktrayaḥ pitre caikaikamubhayatra vā .. 6 ..
1.140.d:
अन्वष्टकासु च तथा भोजयेत्प्रयतो द्विजान् ॥
द्वौ दिव्ये प्राक्त्रयः पित्रे चैकैकमुभयत्र वा ॥ 6 ॥
1.140.m: And likewise on the Anvaṣṭakās, one should attentively feed the twice-born: / two for the divine [ancestors] facing east, three for the fathers, or one in each case.

1.140.s:
udaṅmukhām̐śca pitrarthe snātānvidyādguṇa kramāt ..
tiladarbhāvakīrṇeṣu cāsaneṣūpaveśayet .. 7 ..
1.140.d:
उदङ्मुखाम्̐श्च पित्रर्थे स्नातान्विद्याद्गुण क्रमात् ॥
तिलदर्भावकीर्णेषु चासनेषूपवेशयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.140.m: And for the fathers, [those] facing north who have bathed, in order of learning and virtue, / he should seat upon seats scattered with sesame and darbha grass.

1.140.s:
pitṝnāvāhayāmīti svayamuktvā samāhitaḥ ..
āvāhayasveti tato dvijairukto'tha tanmanāḥ .. 8 ..
1.140.d:
पितॄनावाहयामीति स्वयमुक्त्वा समाहितः ॥
आवाहयस्वेति ततो द्विजैरुक्तोऽथ तन्मनाः ॥ 8 ॥
1.140.m: Having himself said with concentrated mind, 'I summon the ancestors,' / and being then told by the twice-born, 'Summon,' he should focus his mind thereon.

1.140.s:
apayāntvasurā dvābhyāṃ yātudhānavisarjanam ..
tilaiḥ kuryātprayatnena tvathavā gaurasarṣapaiḥ .. 9 ..
1.140.d:
अपयान्त्वसुरा द्वाभ्यां यातुधानविसर्जनम् ॥
तिलैः कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन त्वथवा गौरसर्षपैः ॥ 9 ॥
1.140.m: With the two [verses] 'May the asuras depart,' he should carefully perform / the driving away of the demons with sesame seeds, or else with white mustard seeds.

1.140.s:
ete pitara ityeva sarvāṃstānagna āvaha ..
āgneyantu tathodīrya etadvaḥ pitarastathā .. 1.140.10 ..
1.140.d:
एते पितर इत्येव सर्वांस्तानग्न आवह ॥
आग्नेयन्तु तथोदीर्य एतद्वः पितरस्तथा ॥ 1.140.10 ॥
1.140.m: Reciting [the verse] 'Agni, bring all of them,' namely 'These are the ancestors,' / and likewise the hymn to Agni, and likewise 'This is for you, O ancestors!'

1.140.s:
kuśām̐stilāvamiśreṇa tathā gandhayutena ca ..
yāstiṣṭhanti dhārayanti amṛtāvāgiti tryṛcā .. 11 ..
1.140.d:
कुशाम्̐स्तिलावमिश्रेण तथा गन्धयुतेन च ॥
यास्तिष्ठन्ति धारयन्ति अमृतावागिति त्र्यृचा ॥ 11 ॥
1.140.m: kuśa grass mixed with sesame seeds and combined with perfume, / with the three verses: 'Those which abide,' 'They uphold,' and 'O speech of ambrosia!'

1.140.s:
yanme māteti ca tathā pādyamarghyañca kārayet ..
nivedya vipreṣu tathā pādyārthaṃ prayataḥ kramāt .. 12 ..
1.140.d:
यन्मे मातेति च तथा पाद्यमर्घ्यञ्च कारयेत् ॥
निवेद्य विप्रेषु तथा पाद्यार्थं प्रयतः क्रमात् ॥ 12 ॥
1.140.m: And with 'What my mother...,' he should prepare water for washing the feet and the respectful offering. / Having offered [them] to the brahmins for washing the feet, attentive, in proper order,

1.140.s:
gandhairvastraiśca puṣpaiśca dhūpaiścāpyatha bhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
arcayedbrāhmaṇāñchaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 13 ..
1.140.d:
गन्धैर्वस्त्रैश्च पुष्पैश्च धूपैश्चाप्यथ भूषणैः ॥
अर्चयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छक्त्या श्रद्दधानः समाहितः ॥ 13 ॥
1.140.m: with perfumes, garments, flowers, incenses, and ornaments, / he should worship the brahmins according to his capacity, full of faith and concentrated in mind.

1.140.s:
ādau samarcayedviprānvaiśvadevaniveśitān ..
niveśitām̐śca pitrarthe tataḥ paścātsamarcayet .. 14 ..
1.140.d:
आदौ समर्चयेद्विप्रान्वैश्वदेवनिवेशितान् ॥
निवेशिताम्̐श्च पित्रर्थे ततः पश्चात्समर्चयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.140.m: First he should worship the brahmins seated for the Viśvedevas; / and thereafter he should worship those seated for the sake of the ancestors.

1.140.s:
vaiśvadevaniviṣṭānāṃ caramaṃ hastadhāvanam ..
visarjanaṃ ca nirdiṣṭaṃ teṣu rakṣā yataḥ sthitā .. 15 ..
1.140.d:
वैश्वदेवनिविष्टानां चरमं हस्तधावनम् ॥
विसर्जनं च निर्दिष्टं तेषु रक्षा यतः स्थिता ॥ 15 ॥
1.140.m: The washing of the hands and the dismissal / are prescribed last for those seated for the Viśvedevas, since protection resides in them.

1.140.s:
sarvamanyatpradātavyamādau teṣāṃ narādhipa ..
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpaiśca brāhmaṇānprayatastadā .. 16 ..
1.140.d:
सर्वमन्यत्प्रदातव्यमादौ तेषां नराधिप ॥
संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पैश्च ब्राह्मणान्प्रयतस्तदा ॥ 16 ॥
1.140.m: Everything else is to be given to them first, O king. / Having then attentively honored the brahmins with perfumes and flowers,

1.140.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā dvijānvīkṣya tato japet ..
agnau ca karavāṇīti tairuktaṃ ca kuruṣviti .. 17 ..
1.140.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा द्विजान्वीक्ष्य ततो जपेत् ॥
अग्नौ च करवाणीति तैरुक्तं च कुरुष्विति ॥ 17 ॥
1.140.m: he should then look at the twice-born and recite [the verse] 'The Ādityas, Vasus, and Rudras,' / and [say,] 'May I make [an offering] in the fire?' And being told by them, 'Do make [it]!'

1.140.s:
paristīrya tato vahnimagnimuddhṛtya sarvataḥ ..
āhitāgnistu juhuyāddakṣiṇāgnau samāhitaḥ .. 18 ..
1.140.d:
परिस्तीर्य ततो वह्निमग्निमुद्धृत्य सर्वतः ॥
आहिताग्निस्तु जुहुयाद्दक्षिणाग्नौ समाहितः ॥ 18 ॥
1.140.m: having then strewn around the fire and raised the fire from all sides, / one who maintains the sacred fire should make offerings in the southern fire with a concentrated mind.

1.140.s:
anāhitāgniścaupasade agnyabhāve tathāpsu vā ..
somāyādau pitṛmate kavyavāhanāya cāgnaye .. 19 ..
1.140.d:
अनाहिताग्निश्चौपसदे अग्न्यभावे तथाप्सु वा ॥
सोमायादौ पितृमते कव्यवाहनाय चाग्नये ॥ 19 ॥
1.140.m: One who does not maintain the sacred fire [should make offerings] in the domestic fire, or in water if there is no fire; / first to Soma accompanied by the ancestors, and to Agni who conveys the oblations to the dead,

1.140.s:
yamāya caivāṅgirase hutvā prayatamānasaḥ ..
ye māmakāśca pitara etadvaḥ pitarastathā .. 1.140.20 ..
1.140.d:
यमाय चैवाङ्गिरसे हुत्वा प्रयतमानसः ॥
ये मामकाश्च पितर एतद्वः पितरस्तथा ॥ 1.140.20 ॥
1.140.m: and having made offerings with a focused mind to Yama and to Aṅgiras, / [and having recited] 'Those who are my ancestors,' and likewise 'This is for you, O ancestors!'

1.140.s:
ayaṃ yajñastathaiveti eṣā vo gītirapyatha ..
prayatastanmanāḥ kṛtvā rājam̐ścaivābhimantraṇam .. 21 ..
1.140.d:
अयं यज्ञस्तथैवेति एषा वो गीतिरप्यथ ॥
प्रयतस्तन्मनाः कृत्वा राजम्̐श्चैवाभिमन्त्रणम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.140.m: and likewise 'This sacrifice,' and then this song of yours— / having carefully and with focused mind performed the consecration, O king,

1.140.s:
āmā supakveti tato ghṛtaṃ vāpyathavā payaḥ ..
niṣicya raupyapātreṣu rajatākteṣu bhāvataḥ .. 22 ..
1.140.d:
आमा सुपक्वेति ततो घृतं वाप्यथवा पयः ॥
निषिच्य रौप्यपात्रेषु रजताक्तेषु भावतः ॥ 22 ॥
1.140.m: then with [the verse] 'Raw or well-cooked,' having devotedly poured ghee or milk / into silver vessels or vessels overlaid with silver,

1.140.s:
yathopapanneṣvathavā tūṣṇīmannaṃ nivedayet ..
namo viśvebhya iti ca satilenodakena ca .. 23 ..
1.140.d:
यथोपपन्नेष्वथवा तूष्णीमन्नं निवेदयेत् ॥
नमो विश्वेभ्य इति च सतिलेनोदकेन च ॥ 23 ॥
1.140.m: or into whatever vessels are available, he should offer the food silently, / and with [the mantra] 'Homage to all,' and with water containing sesame seeds.

1.140.s:
prāṅmukheṣu ca yaddattaṃ tadannamupamantrayet ..
udaṅmukheṣu yaddattaṃ nāmagotraprakīrtanaiḥ .. 24 ..
1.140.d:
प्राङ्मुखेषु च यद्दत्तं तदन्नमुपमन्त्रयेत् ॥
उदङ्मुखेषु यद्दत्तं नामगोत्रप्रकीर्तनैः ॥ 24 ॥
1.140.m: And he should consecrate with mantras the food that was given to those facing east; / what was given to those facing north [he should consecrate] by reciting their names and gotras.

1.140.s:
mantrayetprayataḥ prājñaḥ svadhāntaiḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
yanme prakāmāhorātrairyadvā kravyāttathaiva ca .. 25 ..
1.140.d:
मन्त्रयेत्प्रयतः प्राज्ञः स्वधान्तैः सुसमाहितः ॥
यन्मे प्रकामाहोरात्रैर्यद्वा क्रव्यात्तथैव च ॥ 25 ॥
1.140.m: The wise man, attentive and well concentrated, should recite mantras ending in 'svadhā': / 'What [I did] through my desires by day and night,' or 'Whatever [sin], O flesheater,' and likewise.

1.140.s:
itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi cāpyatha ..
saptarcaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ śrāvayedagrato dvijān .. 26 ..
1.140.d:
इतिहासपुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि चाप्यथ ॥
सप्तर्चं परमं मन्त्रं श्रावयेदग्रतो द्विजान् ॥ 26 ॥
1.140.m: Then he should make the twice-born listen in their presence / to the Itihāsas, Purāṇas, Dharmaśāstras, and the supreme seven-verse hymn.

1.140.s:
dakṣiṇāgrāṃstato darbhāṃllūnāṃścaivopamūlataḥ ..
mantritānbrahmamantreṇa vikiretsusamāhitaḥ .. 27 ..
1.140.d:
दक्षिणाग्रांस्ततो दर्भांल्लूनांश्चैवोपमूलतः ॥
मन्त्रितान्ब्रह्ममन्त्रेण विकिरेत्सुसमाहितः ॥ 27 ॥
1.140.m: Then, well concentrated, he should scatter darbha grass / with tips pointing to the south, cut near the root, consecrated with the mantra of Brahmā.

1.140.s:
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātteṣu darbheṣvasaṃśayam ..
madhvājyatilamiśreṇa cānne nāgryeṇa yādava .. 28 ..
1.140.d:
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्यात्तेषु दर्भेष्वसंशयम् ॥
मध्वाज्यतिलमिश्रेण चान्ने नाग्र्येण यादव ॥ 28 ॥
1.140.m: Upon those darbha grasses he should without doubt make the offering of rice-balls, / with the finest food mixed with honey, clarified butter, and sesame, O descendant of Yadu.

1.140.s:
pitṛpiṇḍe bhavenmantraḥ pṛthivī darvirakṣitā ..
paitāmahe bhavenmantrastvantarikṣeti pārthiva .. 29 ..
1.140.d:
पितृपिण्डे भवेन्मन्त्रः पृथिवी दर्विरक्षिता ॥
पैतामहे भवेन्मन्त्रस्त्वन्तरिक्षेति पार्थिव ॥ 29 ॥
1.140.m: For the ball for the father, the mantra should be 'The earth is an imperishable ladle'; / for the grandfather, the mantra should be 'The atmosphere...', O king.

1.140.s:
prapitāmahake mantraṃ dyaurdarviriti kīrtayet ..
ye tatra pitaraḥ pretā mantreṇānena dharmavit .. 1.140.30 ..
1.140.d:
प्रपितामहके मन्त्रं द्यौर्दर्विरिति कीर्तयेत् ॥
ये तत्र पितरः प्रेता मन्त्रेणानेन धर्मवित् ॥ 1.140.30 ॥
1.140.m: For the great-grandfather, he should utter the mantra 'Heaven is the ladle.' / With this mantra, he who knows dharma [should say,] 'Those who are the deceased ancestors there.'

1.140.s:
sūtraṃ nivedayedbhaktyā kṣīrānnaṃ ca nivedayet ..
ūrjaṃ vahantīti tataḥ sānnaṃ dadyādathodakam .. 31 ..
1.140.d:
सूत्रं निवेदयेद्भक्त्या क्षीरान्नं च निवेदयेत् ॥
ऊर्जं वहन्तीति ततः सान्नं दद्यादथोदकम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.140.m: He should devoutly present a thread and present milk-rice. / Then, with [the verse] 'Conveying strength,' he should give water along with food.

1.140.s:
apasavyena piṇḍeṣu śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairbhakṣyaiśca bhojanaiḥ .. 32 ..
1.140.d:
अपसव्येन पिण्डेषु श्रद्धया परया युतः ॥
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपैर्भक्ष्यैश्च भोजनैः ॥ 32 ॥
1.140.m: Filled with supreme faith, with the sacred thread over the right shoulder, upon the rice-balls, / with perfumes, flowers, incenses, lamps, edible foods, and cooked meals,

1.140.s:
pānaiḥ samarcayetpiṇḍānsādaraḥ prayataḥ sadā ..
yatkiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyameva vā .. 33 ..
1.140.d:
पानैः समर्चयेत्पिण्डान्सादरः प्रयतः सदा ॥
यत्किञ्चित्पच्यते गेहे भक्ष्यं वा भोज्यमेव वा ॥ 33 ॥
1.140.m: and with drinks, he should always worship the rice-balls, respectful and attentive. / Whatever is cooked in the house, whether snack or meal,

1.140.s:
anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ tasminnāyatane sadā ..
bhuktavatsvatha vipreṣu vidhiṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu .. 34 ..
1.140.d:
अनिवेद्य न भोक्तव्यं तस्मिन्नायतने सदा ॥
भुक्तवत्स्वथ विप्रेषु विधिं मे गदतः शृणु ॥ 34 ॥
1.140.m: should never be eaten without first offering it in that place. / When the brahmins have eaten, hear from me the rite as it is spoken:

1.140.s:
annaṃ satṛṇamabhyukṣya māmekṣiṣṭheti yatnataḥ ..
udaṅmukhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sodakaṃ tataḥ .. 35 ...
1.140.d:
अन्नं सतृणमभ्युक्ष्य मामेक्षिष्ठेति यत्नतः ॥
उदङ्मुखानां विप्राणां पुरतः सोदकं ततः ॥ 35 ॥।
1.140.m: Having sprinkled food accompanied by grass with the mantra 'Do not look upon me,' / carefully, in front of the brahmins who face north, along with water,

1.140.s:
annantu vikiredbhaktyā pitṛbhāgastu saḥ smṛtaḥ ..
praṣṭavyā brāhmaṇā bhaktyā bhūniviṣṭena jānunā .. 36 ..
1.140.d:
अन्नन्तु विकिरेद्भक्त्या पितृभागस्तु सः स्मृतः ॥
प्रष्टव्या ब्राह्मणा भक्त्या भूनिविष्टेन जानुना ॥ 36 ॥
1.140.m: he should scatter the food with devotion; that is considered the portion of the ancestors. / The brahmins should be questioned with devotion, with knee resting upon the ground:

1.140.s:
tṛptā bhavantaḥ saṃpanno bhavatāṃ kaścideva tu ..
tṛptāḥ smeti ca tairuktaḥ saṃpannamiti cāpyatha .. 37 ..
1.140.d:
तृप्ता भवन्तः संपन्नो भवतां कश्चिदेव तु ॥
तृप्ताः स्मेति च तैरुक्तः संपन्नमिति चाप्यथ ॥ 37 ॥
1.140.m: 'Are you satisfied? Has everything gone well for you?' / And when told by them, 'We are satisfied,' and also 'It has gone well,'

1.140.s:
dadyādācamanaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
yanme rāmaśca śakraśca iti kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāma..38..
1.140.d:
दद्यादाचमनं भक्त्या श्रद्दधानः समाहितः ॥
यन्मे रामश्च शक्रश्च इति कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणाम॥38॥
1.140.m: he should devoutly give water for sipping, faithful and concentrated in mind, / having performed circumambulation with [the verse] 'What Rāma and Śakra [did] for me.'

1.140.s:
pratyekaṃ tarpayedvidvāndakṣiṇābhiḥ svaśaktitaḥ ..
bhavanto'bhiramanviti vācyā viprāstvanantaram .. 39 ..
1.140.d:
प्रत्येकं तर्पयेद्विद्वान्दक्षिणाभिः स्वशक्तितः ॥
भवन्तोऽभिरमन्विति वाच्या विप्रास्त्वनन्तरम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.140.m: The wise man should gratify each of them with sacrificial fees according to his capacity. / Immediately afterwards the brahmins are to be addressed: 'May you take your ease!'

1.140.s:
tairukto'bhiratāḥ smeti dvijānāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ ..
devāśca pitaraśceti japenmantramatandritaḥ .. 1.140.40 ..
1.140.d:
तैरुक्तोऽभिरताः स्मेति द्विजानां पुरतः स्थितः ॥
देवाश्च पितरश्चेति जपेन्मन्त्रमतन्द्रितः ॥ 1.140.40 ॥
1.140.m: When told by them, 'We are at ease,' standing in front of the twice-born, / unwearied, he should recite the mantra 'The gods and the ancestors...'

1.140.s:
pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotreṇa jalaṃ deyamanantaram ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijairvācyaṃ cākṣayaṃ manujeśvara .. 41 ..
1.140.d:
पितॄणां नामगोत्रेण जलं देयमनन्तरम् ॥
ब्राह्मणानां द्विजैर्वाच्यं चाक्षयं मनुजेश्वर ॥ 41 ॥
1.140.m: Immediately afterwards, water should be given to the ancestors by their name and gotra. / And 'May it be inexhaustible' is to be uttered to the brahmins by the twice-born, O lord of men.

1.140.s:
tatastu prārthanā kāryā mantreṇānena bhūmipa ..
dātāro no'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca ..
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahu deyaṃ ca nosviti ..
vājevājeti tūtthāpya kṛtvā caiṣāṃ pradakṣiṇām .. 43 ..
1.140.d:
ततस्तु प्रार्थना कार्या मन्त्रेणानेन भूमिप ॥
दातारो नोऽभिवर्धन्तां वेदाः सन्ततिरेव च ॥
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद्बहु देयं च नोस्विति ॥
वाजेवाजेति तूत्थाप्य कृत्वा चैषां प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.140.m: Then a prayer is to be made with this mantra, O ruler of the earth: / 'May our donors increase, and likewise the Vedas and our progeny; / and may faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!' / Having made them rise with [the hymn] 'Vāje vāje,' and having circumambulated them,

1.140.s:
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā praṇipatya, visarjayet ..
apasavyena kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ narādhipa .. 44 ..
1.140.d:
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा प्रणिपत्य, विसर्जयेत् ॥
अपसव्येन कर्तव्यं पितृकार्यं नराधिप ॥ 44 ॥
1.140.m: touching the ground with both knees and bowing down, he should dismiss them. / The ancestral rites are to be performed with the sacred thread over the right shoulder, O king.

1.140.s:
brāhmaṇairnaiva vaktavyā yadi pṛṣṭā havirguṇāḥ ..
yāvadūṣmā bhavatyanne yāvadaśnanti vāgyatāḥ ...45...
1.140.d:
ब्राह्मणैर्नैव वक्तव्या यदि पृष्टा हविर्गुणाः ॥
यावदूष्मा भवत्यन्ने यावदश्नन्ति वाग्यताः ॥.45॥।
1.140.m: Even if asked, the qualities of the sacrificial food must not be spoken of by the brahmins. / As long as heat remains in the food, and as long as they eat while holding their silence,

1.140.s:
tāvadaśnanti pitaro yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ..
ucchiṣṭamārjanaṃ yāvanna kṛtaṃ nṛpasattama ..46..
1.140.d:
तावदश्नन्ति पितरो यावन्नोक्ता हविर्गुणाः॥
उच्छिष्टमार्जनं यावन्न कृतं नृपसत्तम ॥46॥
1.140.m: so long the ancestors eat, provided the qualities of the food are not spoken of. / As long as the clearing away of the leavings has not been done, O best of kings,

1.140.s:
tāvadaśnanti pitaraḥ svadhā rasavimiśritam ..
hastadattāni lehyāni lavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca..47..
1.140.d:
तावदश्नन्ति पितरः स्वधा रसविमिश्रितम् ॥
हस्तदत्तानि लेह्यानि लवणं व्यञ्जनानि च॥47॥
1.140.m: so long the ancestors partake of it, mixed with the savor of svadhā. / Food to be licked, salt, and condiments given directly by hand

1.140.s:
dātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhanti bhoktā bhuṅkte ca kilbiṣam ..
sauvarṇarājatābhyāntu phalgupātreṇa cāpyatha .. 48 ..
1.140.d:
दातारं नोपतिष्ठन्ति भोक्ता भुङ्क्ते च किल्बिषम् ॥
सौवर्णराजताभ्यान्तु फल्गुपात्रेण चाप्यथ ॥ 48 ॥
1.140.m: do not benefit the giver, and the eater consumes sin. / But what is given in vessels of gold, silver, or light wood,

1.140.s:
dattamakṣayatā yāti khaḍgenodumbareṇa vā ..
māṃsaṃ nāśnāti yaḥ paṅktyāṃ yathāvadviniyojitam..49..
1.140.d:
दत्तमक्षयता याति खड्गेनोदुम्बरेण वा ॥
मांसं नाश्नाति यः पङ्क्त्यां यथावद्विनियोजितम्॥49॥
1.140.m: or in a rhinoceros-horn vessel, or one of udumbara wood, attains imperishability. / One who does not eat meat that has been duly served in the row [of diners]

1.140.s: sa pretya narakaṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 1.140.50 ..
1.140.d: स प्रेत्य नरकं याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 1.140.50 ॥
1.140.m: he goes after death to hell; there should be no doubt about this.

1.140.s:
śrāddhe dātā ca bhoktā ca maithunaṃ yadi gacchataḥ ..
tanmāṃsaṃ pitarastasya bhuñjate retasā yutam ..
evaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śūdreṇāpi narādhipa .. 51 ..
1.140.d:
श्राद्धे दाता च भोक्ता च मैथुनं यदि गच्छतः ॥
तन्मांसं पितरस्तस्य भुञ्जते रेतसा युतम् ॥
एवं श्राद्धं तथा कार्यं शूद्रेणापि नराधिप ॥ 51 ॥
1.140.m: If both the giver and the eater engage in sexual intercourse at a śrāddha, / his ancestors eat that meat mixed with semen. / In this way, the śrāddha should likewise be performed even by a śūdra, O ruler of men.

1.140.s:
mantravarjyaṃ hi śūdrasya sarvametadvidhīyate ..
vajra uvāca ..
yasya jīvetpitā śrāddhaṃ kasyāsau kartumarhati .. 52 ..
1.140.d:
मन्त्रवर्ज्यं हि शूद्रस्य सर्वमेतद्विधीयते ॥
वज्र उवाच ॥
यस्य जीवेत्पिता श्राद्धं कस्यासौ कर्तुमर्हति ॥ 52 ॥
1.140.m: For all this is prescribed for a śūdra without mantras. / Vajra said: / If a man's father is alive, for whom is he entitled to perform a śrāddha?

1.140.s:
tvameva saṃśayacchettā saṃśayaṃ chindhi me dvija ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
yeṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pitā kuryātteṣāmeva sa kārayet ..
mantrahīnaṃ prakartavyaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ yathā vidhi ..53..
1.140.d:
त्वमेव संशयच्छेत्ता संशयं छिन्धि मे द्विज ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
येषां श्राद्धं पिता कुर्यात्तेषामेव स कारयेत् ॥
मन्त्रहीनं प्रकर्तव्यं तेन श्राद्धं यथा विधि ॥53॥
1.140.m: You alone are the resolver of doubts; resolve my doubt, O twice-born! / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / For those for whom the father performs it, he should have it performed for them alone. / The śrāddha should be properly performed by him without mantras, according to rule.

1.140.s:
mātāmahānāṃ śrāddhaṃ tu mantrahīnaṃ ca kārayet ..
śrāddhaṃ ca suhṛdāṃ kuryātstrīṇāṃ cākṣayavācakam .. 54 ..
1.140.d:
मातामहानां श्राद्धं तु मन्त्रहीनं च कारयेत् ॥
श्राद्धं च सुहृदां कुर्यात्स्त्रीणां चाक्षयवाचकम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.140.m: He should also have the śrāddha for maternal grandfathers performed without mantras. / And he should perform the śrāddha for friends, and with the recitation of imperishability for women.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pitā pitāmahaścaiva jīvetāṃ yasya dehinaḥ ..
tena śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ..55..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
पिता पितामहश्चैव जीवेतां यस्य देहिनः ॥
तेन श्राद्धं कथं कार्यं तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥55॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / For an embodied being whose father and grandfather are both alive, / how should the śrāddha be performed by him? Tell me that, as I ask.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
yeṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ kuryātteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ narādhipa ..
tena kāryaṃ mahāprājña yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 56 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
येषां पितामहः कुर्यात्तेषां श्राद्धं नराधिप ॥
तेन कार्यं महाप्राज्ञ यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥ 56 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / For those for whom the grandfather performs it, the śrāddha for them, O ruler of men, / should be performed by him properly in succession, O highly wise one.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ..
yasya jīvanti kartavyaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ dvija .. 57 ..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः ॥
यस्य जीवन्ति कर्तव्यं तेन श्राद्धं कथं द्विज ॥ 57 ॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / If one's father, grandfather, and likewise great-grandfather / are all alive, how is the śrāddha to be performed by him, O twice-born?

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
tena śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ vidhilopaṃ tu yādava ..
pūjanīyāśca pitaraḥ pitāmahapituḥ svayam .. 58 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
तेन श्राद्धं न कर्तव्यं विधिलोपं तु यादव ॥
पूजनीयाश्च पितरः पितामहपितुः स्वयम् ॥ 58 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / No śrāddha should be performed by him, for that would be a breach of ritual rule, O Yādava; / and the ancestors of the grandfather's father should be worshipped by [the great-grandfather] himself.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
jīvetpitāmaho yasya pituścaiva pitāmahaḥ ..
pitā pretastathā yasya tasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada .. 59 ..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
जीवेत्पितामहो यस्य पितुश्चैव पितामहः ॥
पिता प्रेतस्तथा यस्य तस्य श्राद्धविधिं वद ॥ 59 ॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / If one's grandfather is alive and also the father's grandfather, / but the father is deceased, declare the rule of śrāddha for him.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa piturmanujeśvara ..
pituḥ pitāmahādūrdhvaṃ dvābhyāṃ piṇḍaṃ nivedayet ..1.140.60 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कृत्वा स पितुर्मनुजेश्वर ॥
पितुः पितामहादूर्ध्वं द्वाभ्यां पिण्डं निवेदयेत् ॥1.140.60 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having made the offering of the rice-ball for the father, O lord of men, / beyond the father's grandfather, he should offer the rice-ball to two [ancestors].

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pitā pitāmahau pretau yasya syātāṃ dvijottama ..
pituḥ pitāmaho jīvettasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada ..61..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
पिता पितामहौ प्रेतौ यस्य स्यातां द्विजोत्तम ॥
पितुः पितामहो जीवेत्तस्य श्राद्धविधिं वद ॥61॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / If one's father and grandfather are both deceased, O best of the twice-born, / but the father's grandfather is alive, declare the rule of śrāddha for him.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pitre sapitre kṛtvā tu piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tataḥ ..
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātpitāmahapitāmahe..62..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पित्रे सपित्रे कृत्वा तु पिण्डनिर्वपणं ततः ॥
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्यात्पितामहपितामहे॥62॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having made the offering of the rice-ball to the father along with his father, / he should then make the offering of the rice-ball to the grandfather's grandfather.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pretaḥ pitā bhavedyasya pituścaiva pitāmahaḥ ..
tena kāryaṃ kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ..63..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
प्रेतः पिता भवेद्यस्य पितुश्चैव पितामहः ॥
तेन कार्यं कथं श्राद्धं तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥63॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / If one's father is deceased, and also the father's grandfather, / how should the śrāddha be performed by him? Tell me that, as I ask.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
sa tu dattvā pituḥ piṇḍaṃ tataḥ ūrdhvaṃ pitāmahāt ..
dvābhyāṃ dadyātsadā piṇḍaṃ tvevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ .. 64 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
स तु दत्त्वा पितुः पिण्डं ततः ऊर्ध्वं पितामहात् ॥
द्वाभ्यां दद्यात्सदा पिण्डं त्वेवमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥ 64 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having given the rice-ball to the father, then beyond the grandfather / he should always give the rice-ball to two; so say the wise.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pretaḥ pitāmaho yasya pitā jīveddvijottama ..
pituḥ pitāmaho jīvettasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada .. 65 ..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
प्रेतः पितामहो यस्य पिता जीवेद्द्विजोत्तम ॥
पितुः पितामहो जीवेत्तस्य श्राद्धविधिं वद ॥ 65 ॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / If one's grandfather is deceased, the father is alive, O best of the twice-born, / and the father's grandfather is alive, declare the rule of śrāddha for him.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dattvā pitāmahe piṇḍaṃ sa tūrdhvaṃ prapitāmahāt ..
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāddvābhyānnityamatandritaḥ..66..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
दत्त्वा पितामहे पिण्डं स तूर्ध्वं प्रपितामहात् ॥
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्याद्द्वाभ्यान्नित्यमतन्द्रितः॥66॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having given the rice-ball to the grandfather, then beyond the great-grandfather / he should always offer the rice-ball to two, unwearied.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca..
saptārciṣamahaṃ mantraṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārgava ..
śrāddhakālepu niyataṃ rakṣoghnaṃ yasya kīrtitam..67..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच॥
सप्तार्चिषमहं मन्त्रं श्रोतुमिच्छामि भार्गव ॥
श्राद्धकालेपु नियतं रक्षोघ्नं यस्य कीर्तितम्॥67॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / I wish to hear the Saptārcis mantra, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / which is renowned as constantly destroying demons at the time of a śrāddha.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pāpāpahaṃ pāvanīyamaśvamedhasamaṃ tathā ..
mantraṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ tasmādamṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam .. 68 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पापापहं पावनीयमश्वमेधसमं तथा ॥
मन्त्रं वक्ष्याम्यहं तस्मादमृतं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् ॥ 68 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall therefore speak the mantra that removes sins, purifies, / is equal to a horse sacrifice, is immortal, and was created by Brahmā:

1.140.s:
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca ..
namaḥ svadhāyai svāhāyai nityameva bhavatviha ..69..
1.140.d:
देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च महायोगिभ्य एव च ॥
नमः स्वधायै स्वाहायै नित्यमेव भवत्विह ॥69॥
1.140.m: “Homage to the deities, to the ancestors, and to the great yogins! / Homage always to Svadhā, to Svāhā here!”

1.140.s:
ādyevasāne śrāddhasya trivāraṃ tu japetsadā ..
aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyateddvijaiḥ satkṛti pūjitam ..1.140.70..
1.140.d:
आद्येवसाने श्राद्धस्य त्रिवारं तु जपेत्सदा ॥
अश्वमेधफलं ह्यतेद्द्विजैः सत्कृति पूजितम् ॥1.140.70॥
1.140.m: At the beginning and the end of a śrāddha, one should always recite it three times; / for it has the fruit of a horse sacrifice and is honored with reverence by the twice-born.

1.140.s:
piṇḍanirvapaṇe cāpi japedetatsamāhitaḥ ..
pitaraḥ kṣipramāyānti rākṣasāḥ pradravanti ca ..71..
1.140.d:
पिण्डनिर्वपणे चापि जपेदेतत्समाहितः ॥
पितरः क्षिप्रमायान्ति राक्षसाः प्रद्रवन्ति च ॥71॥
1.140.m: At the offering of the rice-ball as well, one should recite this with concentrated mind; / the ancestors come quickly, and the rākṣasas flee away.

1.140.s:
pitṝm̐śca triṣu lokeṣu mantro'yaṃ tārayatyuta ..
paṭhyamānaḥ sadā śrāddhe niyatairbrahmavādibhiḥ ..72..
1.140.d:
पितॄम्̐श्च त्रिषु लोकेषु मन्त्रोऽयं तारयत्युत ॥
पठ्यमानः सदा श्राद्धे नियतैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥72॥
1.140.m: And this mantra delivers the ancestors in the three worlds, / when continuously recited at a śrāddha by restrained knowers of the Veda.

1.140.s:
rājyakāmo japedetatsadā mantramatandritaḥ ..
vīryasarvārthaśauryādiśryāyurbuddhivivardhanam .. ..73..
1.140.d:
राज्यकामो जपेदेतत्सदा मन्त्रमतन्द्रितः ॥
वीर्यसर्वार्थशौर्यादिश्र्यायुर्बुद्धिविवर्धनम् ॥ ॥73॥
1.140.m: One who desires kingship should always recite this mantra unwearied; / it increases vigor, all wealth, valor, prosperity, lifespan, and intellect.

1.140.s:
prīyante pitaronena japena niyamena ca ..
saptārciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham..74..
1.140.d:
प्रीयन्ते पितरोनेन जपेन नियमेन च ॥
सप्तार्चिषं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्॥74॥
1.140.m: The ancestors are pleased by this recitation and discipline. / I shall declare the auspicious Saptārcis, which grants all desires:

1.140.s:
amūrtānāṃ samūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām..
namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyānināṃ yogacakṣuṣām .. 75 ..
1.140.d:
अमूर्तानां समूर्तानां पितॄणां दीप्ततेजसाम्॥
नमस्यामि सदा तेषां ध्यानिनां योगचक्षुषाम् ॥ 75 ॥
1.140.m: “To the formless and the embodied ancestors of blazing radiance, / to those practitioners of meditation endowed with the eye of yoga, I always bow.

1.140.s:
indrādīnāṃ ca netāro dakṣamārīcayostathā ..
saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān ..76 ..
1.140.d:
इन्द्रादीनां च नेतारो दक्षमारीचयोस्तथा ॥
सप्तर्षीणां पितॄणां च तान्नमस्यामि कामदान् ॥76 ॥
1.140.m: The leaders of Indra and the others, and of Dakṣa and Mārīca, / and the ancestors of the seven sages, granting desires—to them I bow.

1.140.s:
manvādīnāṃ ca netāraḥ sūryācandramasostathā ..
tānnamaskṛtya savārnvai pitṝnapsvarṇaveṣu ca .. 77 ..
1.140.d:
मन्वादीनां च नेतारः सूर्याचन्द्रमसोस्तथा ॥
तान्नमस्कृत्य सवार्न्वै पितॄनप्स्वर्णवेषु च ॥ 77 ॥
1.140.m: The leaders of Manu and the others, and of the sun and moon, / having bowed to all those ancestors in the waters and the oceans,

1.140.s:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vāyvagnipitarastathā ..
dyāvāpṛthivyośca tathā namasye tānkṛtāñjaliḥ .. 78 ....
1.140.d:
नक्षत्राणां ग्रहाणां च वाय्वग्निपितरस्तथा ॥
द्यावापृथिव्योश्च तथा नमस्ये तान्कृताञ्जलिः ॥ 78 ॥॥
1.140.m: and of the lunar mansions, the planets, the wind, and fire—the ancestors / of heaven and earth—to them I bow with folded hands.

1.140.s:
devarṣīṇāṃ ca netāraḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtān ..
trātāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ namasye tānpitāmahān .. 79 ..
1.140.d:
देवर्षीणां च नेतारः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतान् ॥
त्रातारः सर्वभूतानां नमस्ये तान्पितामहान् ॥ 79 ॥
1.140.m: The leaders of the divine seers, bowed to by all worlds, / the protectors of all beings—to those grandfathers I bow.

1.140.s:
prajāpatergavāṃ vahneḥ somāya ca yamāya ca ..
yogeśvarebhyaśca tathā namasye tānkṛtāñjaliḥ ..1.140.80..
1.140.d:
प्रजापतेर्गवां वह्नेः सोमाय च यमाय च ॥
योगेश्वरेभ्यश्च तथा नमस्ये तान्कृताञ्जलिः ॥1.140.80॥
1.140.m: To [the ancestors] of Prajāpati, of cattle, of fire, to Soma, and to Yama, / and to the lords of yoga—to them I bow with folded hands.

1.140.s:
pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu ..
svayambhuve namaskṛtya brahmaṇe lokacakṣuṣe ..81..
1.140.d:
पितृगणेभ्यः सप्तभ्यो नमो लोकेषु सप्तसु ॥
स्वयम्भुवे नमस्कृत्य ब्रह्मणे लोकचक्षुषे ॥81॥
1.140.m: Homage to the seven groups of ancestors in the seven worlds!” / Having bowed to the self-existent Brahmā, the eye of the world,

1.140.s:
etattaduktaṃ saptārcirbrahmarṣigaṇapūjitam..
pavitraṃ paramaṃ hyetacchrīmadrakṣovināśanam.. 82 ..
1.140.d:
एतत्तदुक्तं सप्तार्चिर्ब्रह्मर्षिगणपूजितम्॥
पवित्रं परमं ह्येतच्छ्रीमद्रक्षोविनाशनम्॥ 82 ॥
1.140.m: this Saptārcis has been declared, revered by the hosts of brahmin seers; / for this is supremely purifying, glorious, and the destroyer of demons.

1.140.s:
etena vidhinā yuktaḥ trīṇyeva labhate naraḥ ..
annamāyuḥ sutām̐ścaiva vadanti pitaro bhuvi .. 83 ..
1.140.d:
एतेन विधिना युक्तः त्रीण्येव लभते नरः ॥
अन्नमायुः सुताम्̐श्चैव वदन्ति पितरो भुवि ॥ 83 ॥
1.140.m: Endowed with this ritual, a man obtains these three alone: / food, long life, and sons, the ancestors declare on earth.

1.140.s:
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ..
saptārciṣaṃ japedyastu nityameva samāhitaḥ ..
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet..84..
1.140.d:
भक्त्या परमया युक्तः श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
सप्तार्चिषं जपेद्यस्तु नित्यमेव समाहितः ॥
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत्॥84॥
1.140.m: Endowed with supreme devotion, full of faith, with senses mastered, / whoever should always recite the Saptārcis with concentrated mind / becomes the sole sovereign on earth with its seven continents and oceans.

1.140.s:
vajra uvāca..
brahmanmantraṃ samācakṣva sarvarakṣonibarhaṇam..
piṇḍanirvapaṇe yena mantraṇīyāḥ kuśottamāḥ .. 85 ..
1.140.d:
वज्र उवाच॥
ब्रह्मन्मन्त्रं समाचक्ष्व सर्वरक्षोनिबर्हणम्॥
पिण्डनिर्वपणे येन मन्त्रणीयाः कुशोत्तमाः ॥ 85 ॥
1.140.m: Vajra said: / O brahmin, declare the mantra that destroys all demons, / with which the best kuśa grasses are to be consecrated at the offering of the rice-ball.

1.140.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
nihanmi sarvaṃ yadamedhyavadbhaveddhatāśca sarve suradānavā mayā ..
ye rākṣasā yakṣapiśācaguhyakā hatā mayā yātudhānāśca sarve .. 86 ..
1.140.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
निहन्मि सर्वं यदमेध्यवद्भवेद्धताश्च सर्वे सुरदानवा मया ॥
ये राक्षसा यक्षपिशाचगुह्यका हता मया यातुधानाश्च सर्वे ॥ 86 ॥
1.140.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “I destroy everything that is impure; all the gods and Dānavas have been slain by me. / Those rākṣasas, yakṣas, piśācas, and guhyakas, and all the yātudhānas have been slain by me.”

1.140.s:
etena mantreṇa susaṃyatātmā tilānkireddikṣu tathā vidikṣu..
yasmindeśe paṭhate mantra eṣa taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti .. 87 ..
1.140.d:
एतेन मन्त्रेण सुसंयतात्मा तिलान्किरेद्दिक्षु तथा विदिक्षु॥
यस्मिन्देशे पठते मन्त्र एष तं वै देशं राक्षसा वर्जयन्ति ॥ 87 ॥
1.140.m: With this mantra, self-restrained, one should scatter sesame seeds in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / in whichever region this mantra is recited, the rākṣasas avoid that region.

1.141.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
kasmindeśe na kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha ..
kiñca deyamadeyaṃ ca tanme brūhi dvijottama .. 1 ..
1.141.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
कस्मिन्देशे न कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं भृगुकुलोद्वह ॥
किञ्च देयमदेयं च तन्मे ब्रूहि द्विजोत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
1.141.m:
Vajra said:
In which region should a śrāddha not be performed, O upholder of the Bhṛgu race? / And what is to be offered and not to be offered? Tell me that, O best of the twice-born.

1.141.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
triśaṅkuṃ varjayeddeśaṃ sarvaṃ dvādaśayojanam ..
uttareṇa pataṅgasya dakṣiṇena ca kaikaṭam .. .. 2 ..
1.141.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
त्रिशङ्कुं वर्जयेद्देशं सर्वं द्वादशयोजनम् ॥
उत्तरेण पतङ्गस्य दक्षिणेन च कैकटम् ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
1.141.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
One should avoid the entire region of Triśaṅku, twelve yojanas [in extent], / north of Pataṅga and south of Kīkaṭa.

1.141.s:
deśastraiśaṅkavo nāma vivarjyaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ..
kāraskarāḥ kaliṅgāśca sindhoruttarameva ca .. 3 ..
1.141.d:
देशस्त्रैशङ्कवो नाम विवर्ज्यः श्राद्धकर्मणि ॥
कारस्कराः कलिङ्गाश्च सिन्धोरुत्तरमेव च ॥ 3 ॥
1.141.m: The land called Traiśaṅkava is to be shunned in the rite of śrāddha, / [as are] Kāraskara, Kaliṅga, and the north of the Indus River,

1.141.s:
cāturvarṇya vihīnāśca ye ca deśā narādhipa ..
anyeṣvapi ca deśeṣu taddeśajanadarśanam .. 4 ..
1.141.d:
चातुर्वर्ण्य विहीनाश्च ये च देशा नराधिप ॥
अन्येष्वपि च देशेषु तद्देशजनदर्शनम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.141.m: and those regions that are devoid of the four social orders, O king. / Even in other regions, the sight of people from those regions

1.141.s:
varjayecchrāddhakāle tu patitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
rajasvalāśca ṣaṇḍāśca śvānasūkarakukkuṭāḥ .. 5 ..
1.141.d:
वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धकाले तु पतितानां विशेषतः ॥
रजस्वलाश्च षण्डाश्च श्वानसूकरकुक्कुटाः ॥ 5 ॥
1.141.m: one should avoid at the time of śrāddha, especially of outcasts. / Menstruating women, eunuchs, dogs, pigs, and cocks—

1.141.s:
yathā śrāddhaṃ na paśyanti tathā kāryaṃ vijānatā ..
rakṣārthaṃ cāpyathaiteṣāṃ guptiḥ kāryā nareśvara ..6..
1.141.d:
यथा श्राद्धं न पश्यन्ति तथा कार्यं विजानता ॥
रक्षार्थं चाप्यथैतेषां गुप्तिः कार्या नरेश्वर ॥6॥
1.141.m: one who knows should act so that they do not see the śrāddha. / And for their protection, a screening should be made, O lord of men.

1.141.s:
tilāvikiraṇaṃ kāryaṃ yātudhānavināśanam..
piṇḍām̐śca go'javiprebhyo dadyādagnāvatha kṣipet..7..
1.141.d:
तिलाविकिरणं कार्यं यातुधानविनाशनम्॥
पिण्डाम्̐श्च गोऽजविप्रेभ्यो दद्यादग्नावथ क्षिपेत्॥7॥
1.141.m: Scattering of sesamum seeds must be performed to destroy evil spirits. / And he should give the funeral cakes to cows, goats, or brahmins, or cast them into the sacred fire.

1.141.s:
madhyamaṃ putrakāmā vā patnī piṇḍaṃ ca bhakṣayet..
tīrthaśrāddhe sadā piṇḍānkṣipettīrthe vicakṣaṇaḥ.. 8..
1.141.d:
मध्यमं पुत्रकामा वा पत्नी पिण्डं च भक्षयेत्॥
तीर्थश्राद्धे सदा पिण्डान्क्षिपेत्तीर्थे विचक्षणः॥ 8॥
1.141.m: Or a wife desirous of a son should eat the middle funeral cake. / In a śrāddha performed at a sacred ford, the wise person should always cast the funeral cakes into the sacred ford.

1.141.s:
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā paitrī diksā prakīrttitā.
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kuśālābhe vicakṣaṇaiḥ.. 9..
1.141.d:
दक्षिणाभिमुखो भूत्वा पैत्री दिक्सा प्रकीर्त्तिता।
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कार्यं कुशालाभे विचक्षणैः॥ 9॥
1.141.m: Facing south—for that is declared to be the direction of the ancestors— / the offering of funeral cakes should be performed by the wise on kuśa grass, if obtained.

1.141.s:
kuśeṣu rājansarveṣu pavitre te pare mate..
sūtraṃ pradeyaṃ vāso'rthe kṣaumakārpāsasambhavam..1.141.10..
1.141.d:
कुशेषु राजन्सर्वेषु पवित्रे ते परे मते॥
सूत्रं प्रदेयं वासोऽर्थे क्षौमकार्पाससम्भवम्॥1.141.10॥
1.141.m: Kuśa grass is held to be the foremost purifier among all, O king. / A thread should be given for clothing, produced from linen or cotton.

1.141.s:
daśāṃ vivarjayetprājño yadyapyahatavastrajā..
kṣaumakārpāsajaṃ tyaktvā sūtramanyanna dāpayet .. 11 ..
1.141.d:
दशां विवर्जयेत्प्राज्ञो यद्यप्यहतवस्त्रजा॥
क्षौमकार्पासजं त्यक्त्वा सूत्रमन्यन्न दापयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.141.m: The wise man should avoid the fringe, even if it comes from an unwashed garment. / Leaving aside what is produced from linen and cotton, he should not offer any other thread.

1.141.s:
ghṛtena dīpo dātavyastvathavāpyauṣadhīrasaiḥ ..
vasāmedodbhavaṃ dīpaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet .. 12 ..
1.141.d:
घृतेन दीपो दातव्यस्त्वथवाप्यौषधीरसैः ॥
वसामेदोद्भवं दीपं प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.141.m: A lamp should be given with clarified butter, or with herbal oils. / A lamp produced from animal fat or marrow he must assiduously avoid.

1.141.s:
candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumām̐śca pradāpayet ..
aśvamedhasamā hyete pitṝṇāmanulepanāḥ .. 13 ..
1.141.d:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरकुङ्कुमाम्̐श्च प्रदापयेत् ॥
अश्वमेधसमा ह्येते पितॄणामनुलेपनाः ॥ 13 ॥
1.141.m: He should offer sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, and saffron; / these unguents for the ancestors are equal to a horse sacrifice.

1.141.s:
na dātavyaṃ manuṣyendra yadanyaccānulepanam ..
dhūpo guglujo deyastathā candanasārajam .. 14 ..
1.141.d:
न दातव्यं मनुष्येन्द्र यदन्यच्चानुलेपनम् ॥
धूपो गुग्लुजो देयस्तथा चन्दनसारजम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.141.m: No other unguent must be given, O ruler of men. / Incense derived from bdellium should be given, as well as that produced from the essence of sandalwood.

1.141.s:
aguruṃ ca sakarpūraṃ turuṣkaṃ ca pradāpayet ..
ato'nyadapi yatkiṃciddhūpārthe tadvivarjayet..15..
1.141.d:
अगुरुं च सकर्पूरं तुरुष्कं च प्रदापयेत् ॥
अतोऽन्यदपि यत्किंचिद्धूपार्थे तद्विवर्जयेत्॥15॥
1.141.m: And he should offer agallochum with camphor, and olibanum. / Whatever else is intended for incense other than this, he should avoid it.

1.141.s:
saghṛtaṃ gugguluṃ dhūpaṃ dhūpārthe yaḥ prayacchati
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya dhūpadātustathaiva ca..16..
1.141.d:
सघृतं गुग्गुलुं धूपं धूपार्थे यः प्रयच्छति
अश्वमेधफलं तस्य धूपदातुस्तथैव च॥16॥
1.141.m: He who gives bdellium incense mixed with clarified butter as incense / obtains the reward of a horse sacrifice, such is the giver of that incense.

1.141.s:
jātyaśca sarvā dātavyā mallikāśvetayūthikā..
jalodbhavāni sarvāṇi kusumāni vivarjayet .. 17 ..
1.141.d:
जात्यश्च सर्वा दातव्या मल्लिकाश्वेतयूथिका॥
जलोद्भवानि सर्वाणि कुसुमानि विवर्जयेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.141.m: All kinds of jessamine should be given—mallikā and white yūthikā. / All flowers born in water he should avoid,

1.141.s:
yāni kaṇṭakijātāni na deyāni narādhipa ..
yāni kaṇṭakitāgrāṇi śuklāni surabhīṇi ca .. 18 ..
1.141.d:
यानि कण्टकिजातानि न देयानि नराधिप ॥
यानि कण्टकिताग्राणि शुक्लानि सुरभीणि च ॥ 18 ॥
1.141.m: and those born on thorny plants are not to be given, O lord of men. / Those that are tipped with thorns, yet are white and fragrant,

1.141.s:
tāni rājendra deyāni latājāni viśeṣataḥ ..
raktāni jalajātāni tathā deyāni yādava .. 19 ..
1.141.d:
तानि राजेन्द्र देयानि लताजानि विशेषतः ॥
रक्तानि जलजातानि तथा देयानि यादव ॥ 19 ॥
1.141.m: those, O best of kings, should be given, especially those produced on creepers; / likewise red flowers born in water should be given, O descendant of Yadu.

1.141.s:
vipulāṃ śriyamāpnoti pitṝnpuṣpaiḥ samarcayan ..
abhakṣyāṇi vivarjyāni śrāddhe nityamatandritaiḥ .. 1.141.20 ..
1.141.d:
विपुलां श्रियमाप्नोति पितॄन्पुष्पैः समर्चयन् ॥
अभक्ष्याणि विवर्ज्यानि श्राद्धे नित्यमतन्द्रितैः ॥ 1.141.20 ॥
1.141.m: He attains immense prosperity by worshiping the ancestors with flowers. / Things unfit to eat must constantly be avoided in a śrāddha by the vigilant.

1.141.s:
bhakṣyeṣvapi na deyāni yāni tāni nibodha me ..
bhūstṛṇaṃ sumukaṃ śigruṃ pālakyaṃ taṇḍulīyakam .. 21 ..
1.141.d:
भक्ष्येष्वपि न देयानि यानि तानि निबोध मे ॥
भूस्तृणं सुमुकं शिग्रुं पालक्यं तण्डुलीयकम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.141.m: Even among edible foods, learn from me those that must not be given: / bhūstṛṇa grass, sumukha basil, drumstick, spinach, and taṇḍulīyaka,

1.141.s:
kūṣmāṇḍālābuvṛntākapippalīmaricāni ca ..
śrāddheṣu nāgaraṃ deyaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ tathā .. 22 ..
1.141.d:
कूष्माण्डालाबुवृन्ताकपिप्पलीमरिचानि च ॥
श्राद्धेषु नागरं देयं लवणं सैन्धवं तथा ॥ 22 ॥
1.141.m: ash gourd, bottle gourd, eggplant, long pepper, and black pepper. / In śrāddhas, dry ginger may be given, and rock salt.

1.141.s:
saindhavavyatirekeṇa lavaṇāni na dāpayet ..
naktaṃ gṛhītamudakaṃ tathā palvalasambhavam .. 23 ..
1.141.d:
सैन्धवव्यतिरेकेण लवणानि न दापयेत् ॥
नक्तं गृहीतमुदकं तथा पल्वलसम्भवम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.141.m: Apart from rock salt, one should not give other salts. / Water gathered at night, as well as that produced from a puddle,

1.141.s:
śrāddhakāle vivarjyaṃ ca māhiṣaṃ kṣīrameva ca ..
rājamāṣamasūrāśca caṇakā koradūṣakāḥ .. 24 ..
1.141.d:
श्राद्धकाले विवर्ज्यं च माहिषं क्षीरमेव च ॥
राजमाषमसूराश्च चणका कोरदूषकाः ॥ 24 ॥
1.141.m: must be avoided at the time of śrāddha, as well as buffalo milk, / cowpeas, lentils, chickpeas, and koradūṣaka grain.

1.141.s:
varjyāścābhiṣavo nityaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ gavedhukam ..
karambhāṇi kusumbhaṃ ca paṭolaṃ bṛhatīphalam .. 25 ..
1.141.d:
वर्ज्याश्चाभिषवो नित्यं शतपुष्पं गवेधुकम् ॥
करम्भाणि कुसुम्भं च पटोलं बृहतीफलम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.141.m: Fermented liquors must always be avoided, as well as dill and gavedhuka grass, / gruels, safflower, pointed gourd, and large nightshade fruit,

1.141.s:
karīrasurabhī cobhau pūtigandhi ca yadbhavet ..
jambīrajaphalaṃ varjyaṃ kovidāraṃ ca pārthiva .. 26 ..
1.141.d:
करीरसुरभी चोभौ पूतिगन्धि च यद्भवेत् ॥
जम्बीरजफलं वर्ज्यं कोविदारं च पार्थिव ॥ 26 ॥
1.141.m: both karīra and surabhi, and whatever is foul-smelling. / The fruit of the citron tree is to be avoided, as well as kovidāra, O king.

1.141.s:
vastusaṃdarśanaṃ śastaṃ śrāddhe nityamarindama ..
kutapasya ca sānnidhyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājinasya ca .. 27 ..
1.141.d:
वस्तुसंदर्शनं शस्तं श्राद्धे नित्यमरिन्दम ॥
कुतपस्य च सान्निध्यं तथा कृष्णाजिनस्य च ॥ 27 ॥
1.141.m: The sight of worthy items is always praised in a śrāddha, O tamer of enemies, / along with the presence of a kutapa blanket and of a black antelope skin.

1.141.s:
kṛṣṇājinasya dānaṃ ca rajatasya viśeṣataḥ ..
kṛṣṇājinaṃ sakutapaṃ kṛṣṇāni ca tilāni ca .. 28 ..
1.141.d:
कृष्णाजिनस्य दानं च रजतस्य विशेषतः ॥
कृष्णाजिनं सकुतपं कृष्णानि च तिलानि च ॥ 28 ॥
1.141.m: The gifting of a black antelope skin is praised, especially with silver. / A black antelope skin along with a kutapa blanket and black sesamum seeds

1.141.s:
śrāddhakarmaṇi śastāni viṭpatistatsutastathā ..
somaḥ sadaiva māsānte raviṇā saha saṃgataḥ .. 29 ..
1.141.d:
श्राद्धकर्मणि शस्तानि विट्पतिस्तत्सुतस्तथा ॥
सोमः सदैव मासान्ते रविणा सह संगतः ॥ 29 ॥
1.141.m: are commended in a śrāddha rite, and likewise a daughter's husband and his son. / Soma, conjoining with the sun always at the end of the month,

1.141.s:
āpaścaivauṣadhīścaiva tadā viśati pārthiva ..
amāyāṃ tu payaḥ pītvā bhuktvā caivauṣadhīḥ śubhāḥ .. 1.141.30 ..
1.141.d:
आपश्चैवौषधीश्चैव तदा विशति पार्थिव ॥
अमायां तु पयः पीत्वा भुक्त्वा चैवौषधीः शुभाः ॥ 1.141.30 ॥
1.141.m: enters the waters and the herbs at that time, O king. / Drinking the water on the new moon and consuming the auspicious herbs,

1.141.s:
payaḥ kṣaranti yaddivyaṃ gāvo'mṛtarasopamam ..
tatpavitraṃ paraṃ rājankāpilaṃ cedviśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
1.141.d:
पयः क्षरन्ति यद्दिव्यं गावोऽमृतरसोपमम् ॥
तत्पवित्रं परं राजन्कापिलं चेद्विशेषतः ॥ 31 ॥
1.141.m: the celestial milk resembling nectar which cows pour out / is supremely pure, O king, especially if from a brown cow.

1.141.s:
havye kavye ca tadrājansomatulyaṃ prakīrtitam ..
tilairvrīhiyavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalena ca .. 32 ...
priyaṅgubhistathā dāraiḥ śṛṅgāṭakaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
godhūmaiścekṣubhirmudgaiḥ sacīnacaṇakaistathā .. 33 ..
1.141.d:
हव्ये कव्ये च तद्राजन्सोमतुल्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
तिलैर्व्रीहियवैर्माषैरद्भिर्मूलफलेन च ॥ 32 ॥।
प्रियङ्गुभिस्तथा दारैः शृङ्गाटकफलैः शुभैः ॥
गोधूमैश्चेक्षुभिर्मुद्गैः सचीनचणकैस्तथा ॥ 33 ॥
1.141.m: In offerings to gods and ancestors that [milk], O king, is declared equal to soma. / With sesamum, rice, barley, black gram, water, roots, and fruits, / with priyaṅgu, dāra, and auspicious water chestnuts, / with wheat, sugarcane, mung beans, and common millet and chickpeas,

1.141.s:
śyāmākairhastiśyāmākairmadhūkairhavyadāḍimaiḥ ..
panasairnārikeraiśca kharjūrāmraphalaistathā .. 34 ..
1.141.d:
श्यामाकैर्हस्तिश्यामाकैर्मधूकैर्हव्यदाडिमैः ॥
पनसैर्नारिकेरैश्च खर्जूराम्रफलैस्तथा ॥ 34 ॥
1.141.m: with wild rice, large wild rice, madhūka blossoms, and sacrosanct pomegranates, / with jackfruits, coconuts, dates, and mangoes,

1.141.s:
āmrātaiścāmranāraṃgairbilvairdīrghaiśca mūlakaiḥ ..
vidāryānirbharūṭaiśca viśeṣaśca varāṭakaiḥ .. 35 ..
1.141.d:
आम्रातैश्चाम्रनारंगैर्बिल्वैर्दीर्घैश्च मूलकैः ॥
विदार्यानिर्भरूटैश्च विशेषश्च वराटकैः ॥ 35 ॥
1.141.m: with hog-plums, mango-oranges, wood-apples, long radishes, / vidārī, wild dates, and especially cowrie beans,

1.141.s:
picukaiśca tathā kardairbadaraiḥ karakandubhiḥ ..
pālevatai rāṣṭrakaiśca akṣoṭaiḥ panasaistathā .. 36 ..
1.141.d:
पिचुकैश्च तथा कर्दैर्बदरैः करकन्दुभिः ॥
पालेवतै राष्ट्रकैश्च अक्षोटैः पनसैस्तथा ॥ 36 ॥
1.141.m: with picukas, kardas, jujubes, and small wild jujubes, / with pālevatas, walnuts, and jackfruits,

1.141.s:
kākolaiḥ kṣīrakākolaistathā piṇḍālukaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
suvarcalāmadhūkaiśca vāstukena ca pārthiva ..37..
1.141.d:
काकोलैः क्षीरकाकोलैस्तथा पिण्डालुकैः शुभैः ॥
सुवर्चलामधूकैश्च वास्तुकेन च पार्थिव ॥37॥
1.141.m: with kākolī and kṣīrakākolī bulbs, and auspicious sweet potatoes, / with suvarcalā, madhūka, and goosefoot greens, O king,

1.141.s:
sitākhaṇḍaguḍairmukhyaiḥ phaṇitena ca saktubhiḥ ..
lājābhiśca sadānābhistrapusairvārucirbhaṭaiḥ .. 38 ..
1.141.d:
सिताखण्डगुडैर्मुख्यैः फणितेन च सक्तुभिः ॥
लाजाभिश्च सदानाभिस्त्रपुसैर्वारुचिर्भटैः ॥ 38 ॥
1.141.m: with sugar candy, molasses, treacle, and roasted barley meal, / with parched grain, cucumbers, and melons,

1.141.s:
sarṣapārājaśākābhyāmiṅgudai rājajambubhiḥ ..
priyālāmalakairmukhyaiḥ phalgubhiśca tilolakaiḥ .. 39 ..
1.141.d:
सर्षपाराजशाकाभ्यामिङ्गुदै राजजम्बुभिः ॥
प्रियालामलकैर्मुख्यैः फल्गुभिश्च तिलोलकैः ॥ 39 ॥
1.141.m: with mustard greens, royal leafy greens, inguda, and rose apples, / with excellent priyāla and myrobalans, figs, and sesame-infused cakes,

1.141.s:
vetrāṅkuraistāladarbhaiścukrīkākṣīrikādhavaiḥ ..
cocaiḥ samīcairlakucaistathā vai bījapūrakaiḥ .. 1.141.40 ..
1.141.d:
वेत्राङ्कुरैस्तालदर्भैश्चुक्रीकाक्षीरिकाधवैः ॥
चोचैः समीचैर्लकुचैस्तथा वै बीजपूरकैः ॥ 1.141.40 ॥
1.141.m: with cane shoots, palm sprouts, sorrel, kṣīrikā, and dhava leaves, / with cinnamon, wood apples, and citrons,

1.141.s:
chatrāticchatrakṣīrākaiḥ kalaṇḍukakaśerukaiḥ ..
sujātakaiḥ padmaphalairbhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ .. 41 ..
1.141.d:
छत्रातिच्छत्रक्षीराकैः कलण्डुककशेरुकैः ॥
सुजातकैः पद्मफलैर्भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैः सुसंस्कृतैः ॥ 41 ॥
1.141.m: with mushrooms, kṣīrāka, and kalaṇḍuka and kaśeruka tubers, / with lotus seeds, delicacies, and well-prepared dishes,

1.141.s:
rāgaṣāḍhavacoṇyaiśca trijātakasamanvitaiḥ ..
dattena māsaṃ prīyante śrāddhena pitaro nṛṇām .. 42 ..
1.141.d:
रागषाढवचोण्यैश्च त्रिजातकसमन्वितैः ॥
दत्तेन मासं प्रीयन्ते श्राद्धेन पितरो नृणाम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.141.m: with condiments, spiced sweet drinks, and the three aromatics— / through such a śrāddha offered, the ancestors of men are gratified for a month.

1.141.s:
dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīnmāsānhāriṇena tu ..
aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākunena ca pañca vai .. 43 ..
1.141.d:
द्वौ मासौ मत्स्यमांसेन त्रीन्मासान्हारिणेन तु ॥
औरभ्रेणाथ चतुरः शाकुनेन च पञ्च वै ॥ 43 ॥
1.141.m: For two months with fish meat, and for three months with deer meat; / for four months with mutton, and indeed five with bird meat;

1.141.s:
ṣaṇmāsāñchāśikenāpi sapta pāriśatena ca ..
tathāṣṭau chāgamāṃsena payasā pāyasena ca .. 44 ..
1.141.d:
षण्मासाञ्छाशिकेनापि सप्त पारिशतेन च ॥
तथाष्टौ छागमांसेन पयसा पायसेन च ॥ 44 ॥
1.141.m: for six months with hare, and seven with pāriśata venison; / likewise for eight with goat meat, and with milk and milk-rice pudding.

1.141.s:
vārāheṇa navaivāhū rauraveṇa tathā daśa ..
māsānekādaśaivāhurgavayena narādhipa .. 45 ..
1.141.d:
वाराहेण नवैवाहू रौरवेण तथा दश ॥
मासानेकादशैवाहुर्गवयेन नराधिप ॥ 45 ॥
1.141.m: They say nine [months] with boar's meat, and ten with deer's meat; / they say eleven months with gayal meat, O king.

1.141.s:
saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena ca ..
payovikāraiśca tathā hṛdyaiśca manujeśvara .. 46 ..
1.141.d:
संवत्सरं तु गव्येन पयसा पायसेन च ॥
पयोविकारैश्च तथा हृद्यैश्च मनुजेश्वर ॥ 46 ॥
1.141.m: For a year with cow's milk and with rice boiled in milk, / and likewise with delightful milk-products, O lord of men,

1.141.s:
pānakaiśca tathā hṛdyaistrisugandhaiḥ suśītalaiḥ...
vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī .. 47 ..
1.141.d:
पानकैश्च तथा हृद्यैस्त्रिसुगन्धैः सुशीतलैः॥।
वार्ध्रीणसस्य मांसेन तृप्तिर्द्वादशवार्षिकी ॥ 47 ॥
1.141.m: and with delightful, cool drinks fragranced with the three perfumes. / With the meat of the vārdhrīṇasa, satisfaction lasts twelve years.

1.141.s:
vajra uvāca ..
vārdhrīṇasamahaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ..
yasya māṃsena kathitā tṛptirdvādaśa vārṣikī .. 48 ..
1.141.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
वार्ध्रीणसमहं ब्रह्मञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
यस्य मांसेन कथिता तृप्तिर्द्वादश वार्षिकी ॥ 48 ॥
1.141.m: Vajra said: / O brahmin, I wish to hear in truth about the vārdhrīṇasa, / by whose meat satisfaction is said to last twelve years.

1.141.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
tripibantvindriyakṣīṇaṃ yūthasyāgrasaraṃ tathā..
raktaṃ varṇena rājendra chāgaṃ vārdhrīṇasaṃ viduḥ ..49..
1.141.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
त्रिपिबन्त्विन्द्रियक्षीणं यूथस्याग्रसरं तथा॥
रक्तं वर्णेन राजेन्द्र छागं वार्ध्रीणसं विदुः ॥49॥
1.141.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Drinking by three, with withered senses, the leader of the herd, / and red in color, O best of kings—such a goat they know as the vārdhrīṇasa.

1.141.s:
kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ānantyāya bhaveddattaṃ sarvaṃ ca madhusaṃyutam .. 1.141.50 ..
1.141.d:
कालशाकं महाशल्कं खड्गमांसं तथैव च ॥
आनन्त्याय भवेद्दत्तं सर्वं च मधुसंयुतम् ॥ 1.141.50 ॥
1.141.m: Kālaśāka greens, mahāśalka fish, and rhinoceros meat as well— / all given mixed with honey, leads to endlessness.

1.141.s:
khaḍgā viṣāṇaiḥ parivarjitā ye teṣāṃ hi māṃsena bhavatyanantam ..
śrāddhaṃ mahārāja tataḥ pradeyaṃ khaḍgasya māṃsena hitāya teṣām .. 51 ..
1.141.d:
खड्गा विषाणैः परिवर्जिता ये तेषां हि मांसेन भवत्यनन्तम् ॥
श्राद्धं महाराज ततः प्रदेयं खड्गस्य मांसेन हिताय तेषाम् ॥ 51 ॥
1.141.m: Indeed, with the meat of those rhinoceroses who are devoid of horns, it becomes endless; / therefore, O great king, a śrāddha should be offered with rhinoceros meat for their benefit.

1.142.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
śrāddhakālaṃ samācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ..
kasminkāle kṛte śrāddhe prīyante pitaro nṛṇām .. 1 ..
1.142.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
श्राद्धकालं समाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ॥
कस्मिन्काले कृते श्राद्धे प्रीयन्ते पितरो नृणाम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.142.m: Vajra said: / Explain the time for the śrāddha, O best of upholders of all dharma. / Performed at what time are the ancestors of men pleased?

1.142.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śrāddhakālastvamāvasyāṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama ..
paurṇamāsī tathā māghī śrāvaṇī ca narottama ..2..
1.142.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
श्राद्धकालस्त्वमावस्यां नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
पौर्णमासी तथा माघी श्रावणी च नरोत्तम ॥2॥
1.142.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The time for the regular śrāddha is on the new moon, O best of kings; / likewise the full moon in Māgha and that in Śrāvaṇa, O best of men;

1.142.s:
proṣṭhapadyāmatītāyāṃ tathā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī ..
āgrahāyaṇyatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇāstisro'ṣṭakāstathā ..3..
1.142.d:
प्रोष्ठपद्यामतीतायां तथा कृष्णत्रयोदशी ॥
आग्रहायण्यतीतायां कृष्णास्तिस्रोऽष्टकास्तथा ॥3॥
1.142.m: when the full moon of Bhādrapada has passed, on the thirteenth of the dark fortnight; / and when the full moon of Mārgaśīrṣa has passed, the three dark aṣṭakā days;

1.142.s:
śākaiśca prathamaṃ kāryā māṃsaiśca tadanantarā ..
tṛtīyā ca tathā'pūpairnityameva vijānatā .. 4 ..
1.142.d:
शाकैश्च प्रथमं कार्या मांसैश्च तदनन्तरा ॥
तृतीया च तथाऽपूपैर्नित्यमेव विजानता ॥ 4 ॥
1.142.m: and the first must be performed with vegetables, the next with meat, / and the third with cakes, always by one who knows.

1.142.s:
anvaṣṭakāsu ca strīṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathaiva ca ..
aṣṭakāvidhinā hutvā krameṇaitāstu pañcakāḥ .. 5..
1.142.d:
अन्वष्टकासु च स्त्रीणां श्राद्धं कार्यं तथैव च ॥
अष्टकाविधिना हुत्वा क्रमेणैतास्तु पञ्चकाः ॥ 5॥
1.142.m: And on the anvaṣṭakā days, the śrāddha for women should be performed in the same way. / Having sacrificed according to the rule of the aṣṭakā, these are five in succession.

1.142.s:
mātre rājanpitāmahyai śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi ..
tathaiva prapitāmahyai viśvedevapurassaram ..6..
1.142.d:
मात्रे राजन्पितामह्यै श्राद्धं कार्यं यथाविधि ॥
तथैव प्रपितामह्यै विश्वेदेवपुरस्सरम् ॥6॥
1.142.m: The śrāddha should be performed according to rule for the mother, O king, for the paternal grandmother, / and likewise for the paternal great-grandmother, preceded by the Viśvedevas.

1.142.s:
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tāsāṃ ca pitṛvannṛpa..
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu tatra karma nibodha me .. 7 ..
1.142.d:
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कार्यं तासां च पितृवन्नृप॥
भुक्तवत्सु च विप्रेषु तत्र कर्म निबोध मे ॥ 7 ॥
1.142.m: The offering of rice-balls should be performed for them like for the fathers, O king. / When the brahmins have eaten, listen to the rite then from me:

1.142.s:
prādeśamātrā rājendra caturaṃgulamāyatāḥ ..
tāvadeva samutsedhāḥ ṣaṭkarṣūstatra kārayet .. 8 ..
1.142.d:
प्रादेशमात्रा राजेन्द्र चतुरंगुलमायताः ॥
तावदेव समुत्सेधाः षट्कर्षूस्तत्र कारयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
1.142.m: a span in measurement, O best of kings, four finger-breadths wide, / and of the same height, one should make six trenches there.

1.142.s:
pratyekakarṣumūle tu paristīrya hutāśanam ..
agnisomayamānāṃ ca yāgaṃ kṛtvā yathā purā .. 9 ..
1.142.d:
प्रत्येककर्षुमूले तु परिस्तीर्य हुताशनम् ॥
अग्निसोमयमानां च यागं कृत्वा यथा पुरा ॥ 9 ॥
1.142.m: At the base of each trench, strewing around the fire / and having performed the sacrifice to Agni, Soma, and Yama as before,

1.142.s:
karṣutritayamūle tu puruṣāṇāṃ tu kārayet ..
piṇḍa nirvapaṇaṃ prāgvadekaikasminyathāvidhi .. 1.142.10 ..
1.142.d:
कर्षुत्रितयमूले तु पुरुषाणां तु कारयेत् ॥
पिण्ड निर्वपणं प्राग्वदेकैकस्मिन्यथाविधि ॥ 1.142.10 ॥
1.142.m: at the base of three trenches he should make the offering of rice-balls / for the men as before, according to rule for each one.

1.142.s:
karṣūbhistritayaṃ tacca kṣīrānnādbhiḥ prapūrayet ..
karṣutritayamūle tu strīṇāṃ nirvapaṇaṃ bhavet .. 11 ...
1.142.d:
कर्षूभिस्त्रितयं तच्च क्षीरान्नाद्भिः प्रपूरयेत् ॥
कर्षुत्रितयमूले तु स्त्रीणां निर्वपणं भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥।
1.142.m: And he should fill those three trenches with milk, boiled rice, and water. / At the base of the other three trenches, the offering should be for the women.

1.142.s:
dadhnā māṃsena payasā karṣūṇāṃ caiva pūraṇam ..
annodakavimiśreṇa kāryaṃ manujapuṅgava .. 12 ..
1.142.d:
दध्ना मांसेन पयसा कर्षूणां चैव पूरणम् ॥
अन्नोदकविमिश्रेण कार्यं मनुजपुङ्गव ॥ 12 ॥
1.142.m: And the filling of the trenches should be made with curd, meat, and milk, / mixed with food and water, O bull among men.

1.142.s:
bhavantībhyo bhavatvetadakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam ..
etāni śrāddhakālāni nityānyāha prajāpatiḥ .. 13 ..
1.142.d:
भवन्तीभ्यो भवत्वेतदक्षयं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
एतानि श्राद्धकालानि नित्यान्याह प्रजापतिः ॥ 13 ॥
1.142.m: Saying 'May this be imperishable for you women!'—this is proclaimed. / These times for the regular śrāddha Prajāpati has spoken;

1.142.s:
śrāddhameteṣvakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate ..
vṛddhau śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kurvannityaṃ vṛddhimupāśnute .. 14 ..
1.142.d:
श्राद्धमेतेष्वकुर्वाणो नरकं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
वृद्धौ श्राद्धं नरः कुर्वन्नित्यं वृद्धिमुपाश्नुते ॥ 14 ॥
1.142.m: not performing the śrāddha at these, a man falls into hell. / Performing the śrāddha at times of prosperity, a man always attains prosperity.

1.142.s:
vṛddhau samarcayedvidvānnityaṃ nāndīmukhānpitṝn ..
vṛdiśrāddheṣu kartavyāstilasthāne yavāstathā .. 15 ..
1.142.d:
वृद्धौ समर्चयेद्विद्वान्नित्यं नान्दीमुखान्पितॄन् ॥
वृदिश्राद्धेषु कर्तव्यास्तिलस्थाने यवास्तथा ॥ 15 ॥
1.142.m: At a time of prosperity, the wise man should always worship the Nāndīmukha ancestors. / In prosperity-śrāddhas, barley grains should be used instead of sesame seeds,

1.142.s:
karkandhudadhisaṃmiśrām̐stathā piṇḍām̐śca nirvapet ...
acchinnanābhyāṃ kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai putrajanmani .. 16 ..
1.142.d:
कर्कन्धुदधिसंमिश्राम्̐स्तथा पिण्डाम्̐श्च निर्वपेत् ॥।
अच्छिन्ननाभ्यां कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं वै पुत्रजन्मनि ॥ 16 ॥
1.142.m: and one should offer rice-balls mixed with jujube fruit and curd. / The śrāddha should indeed be performed upon the birth of a son before the navel-string is cut,

1.142.s:
āśaucoparame kāryamathavā'pi narādhipa ..
vivāhadivase śrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..17 ..
1.142.d:
आशौचोपरमे कार्यमथवाऽपि नराधिप ॥
विवाहदिवसे श्राद्धं तथा कार्यं विचक्षणैः ॥17 ॥
1.142.m: or else it should be performed when ritual impurity has ceased, O king. / On the day of a wedding, a śrāddha should likewise be performed by the wise.

1.142.s:
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ vidhānena candre janmarkṣamāśrite ..
śrāddhaṃ prayatnātkartavyaṃ bhūtikāmena pārthiva .. 18 ..
1.142.d:
वृद्धिश्राद्धं विधानेन चन्द्रे जन्मर्क्षमाश्रिते ॥
श्राद्धं प्रयत्नात्कर्तव्यं भूतिकामेन पार्थिव ॥ 18 ॥
1.142.m: The prosperity-śrāddha should be performed according to rule when the moon has entered the birth constellation; / the śrāddha should be performed diligently by one desiring prosperity, O king.

1.142.s:
uttarādayanācchrāddhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ syāddakṣiṇāyane ..
cāturmāsyaṃ ca tatrāpi prasupte keśave hitam ..19 ..
1.142.d:
उत्तरादयनाच्छ्राद्धं श्रेष्ठं स्याद्दक्षिणायने ॥
चातुर्मास्यं च तत्रापि प्रसुप्ते केशवे हितम् ॥19 ॥
1.142.m: A śrāddha during the southern course of the sun is superior to one during the northern course; / and even then, during the four rainy months when Keśava is asleep, it is beneficial.

1.142.s:
proṣṭhapadyaparaṃ pakṣaṃ tathāpi ca viśeṣavat ..
pañcamyūrdhvaṃ ca tatrāpi daśamyūrdhvaṃ tato'pyati..1.142.20..
1.142.d:
प्रोष्ठपद्यपरं पक्षं तथापि च विशेषवत् ॥
पञ्चम्यूर्ध्वं च तत्रापि दशम्यूर्ध्वं ततोऽप्यति॥1.142.20॥
1.142.m: Even so, the fortnight after the full moon of Bhādrapada is especially auspicious; / and even then, after the fifth day, and still more after the tenth day;

1.142.s:
maghāyutā ca tatrāpi śastā rājaṃstrayodaśī ..
tatrākṣayyaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ madhunā pāyasena ca .. 21 ..
1.142.d:
मघायुता च तत्रापि शस्ता राजंस्त्रयोदशी ॥
तत्राक्षय्यं भवेच्छ्राद्धं मधुना पायसेन च ॥ 21 ॥
1.142.m: and even then, O king, the thirteenth day conjoined with Maghā is praised. / A śrāddha there with honey and rice boiled in milk becomes imperishable.

1.142.s:
sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddhamatra narādhipa ..
parānnabhojī tvapacaḥ śrāddhamatra tu kārayet .. 22 ..
1.142.d:
सर्वस्वेनापि कर्तव्यं श्राद्धमत्र नराधिप ॥
परान्नभोजी त्वपचः श्राद्धमत्र तु कारयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.142.m: A śrāddha should be performed on this day even with all one's possessions, O king. / One who eats another's food and does not cook should have a śrāddha performed here;

1.142.s:
yastu śrāddhaṃ sadā kuryātso'śvamedhaphalo bhavet ..
nidrāṃ tyajati sarvātmā yasminkāle janārdanaḥ .. 23..
1.142.d:
यस्तु श्राद्धं सदा कुर्यात्सोऽश्वमेधफलो भवेत् ॥
निद्रां त्यजति सर्वात्मा यस्मिन्काले जनार्दनः ॥ 23॥
1.142.m: he who always performs a śrāddha attains the fruit of an horse sacrifice. / At the time when Janārdana, the soul of all, gives up sleep,

1.142.s:
tatra śrāddhamathānantyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
śrāddhaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānoḥ kartavyaṃ pṛthivīpate .. 24 ..
1.142.d:
तत्र श्राद्धमथानन्त्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
श्राद्धं संक्रमणे भानोः कर्तव्यं पृथिवीपते ॥ 24 ॥
1.142.m: a śrāddha then is endless; no doubt should be entertained here. / A śrāddha should be performed at the transit of the sun, O lord of the earth;

1.142.s:
viṣuvaddvitayaṃ tatra ayane dve viśeṣataḥ ..
vyatīpāte tathā śrāddhaṃ jñeyaṃ bahuphalaṃ nṛpa .. 25 ..
1.142.d:
विषुवद्द्वितयं तत्र अयने द्वे विशेषतः ॥
व्यतीपाते तथा श्राद्धं ज्ञेयं बहुफलं नृप ॥ 25 ॥
1.142.m: especially at the two equinoxes and at the two solstices. / Likewise, a śrāddha at Vyatīpāta should be known to bear great fruit, O king;

1.142.s:
akṣayyaṃ ca tathā śrāddhaṃ vijñeyaṃ rāhudarśane ..
vrīhipāke ca kartavyaṃ yavapāke tathaiva ca .. 26 ..
1.142.d:
अक्षय्यं च तथा श्राद्धं विज्ञेयं राहुदर्शने ॥
व्रीहिपाके च कर्तव्यं यवपाके तथैव च ॥ 26 ॥
1.142.m: and a śrāddha at an eclipse of the sun or moon should be known as imperishable. / It should also be performed when the rice ripens, and likewise when the barley ripens;

1.142.s:
na tānadyurmahārāja vinā śrāddhaṃ kathaṃcana ..
āśvinasyāpare pakṣe prathame kārtikasya ca .. 27 ..
1.142.d:
न तानद्युर्महाराज विना श्राद्धं कथंचन ॥
आश्विनस्यापरे पक्षे प्रथमे कार्तिकस्य च ॥ 27 ॥
1.142.m: they must by no means eat them without a śrāddha, O great king. / In the dark fortnight of Āśvina and the bright fortnight of Kārtika,

1.142.s:
pūrvāhne śuklapakṣasya śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
aparāhṇe tathā kāryaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe narādhipa .. 28 ..
1.142.d:
पूर्वाह्ने शुक्लपक्षस्य श्राद्धं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
अपराह्णे तथा कार्यं कृष्णपक्षे नराधिप ॥ 28 ॥
1.142.m: the wise man should perform the śrāddha in the forenoon during the bright fortnight; / and it should be performed in the afternoon during the dark fortnight, O king.

1.142.s:
saṃdhyayorvarjastechrāddhaṃ tatra rātrau nareśvara ..
rātrāvapi ca kartavyaṃ yadā syādrāhudarśanam .. 29 ..
1.142.d:
संध्ययोर्वर्जस्तेछ्राद्धं तत्र रात्रौ नरेश्वर ॥
रात्रावपि च कर्तव्यं यदा स्याद्राहुदर्शनम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.142.m: A śrāddha should be avoided at the two twilights and during the night, O ruler of men; / yet it should be performed even at night when there is an eclipse of the sun or moon.

1.142.s:
akṣayyaṃ tatsamuddiṣṭaṃ yaddattaṃ rāhudarśane ..
ataḥ kāmyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhāni tava pārthiva.. 1.142.30 ..
1.142.d:
अक्षय्यं तत्समुद्दिष्टं यद्दत्तं राहुदर्शने ॥
अतः काम्यानि वक्ष्यामि श्राद्धानि तव पार्थिव॥ 1.142.30 ॥
1.142.m: What is given during an eclipse is declared imperishable. / Hereafter I shall declare to you optional śrāddhas, O king.

1.142.s:
arogyamatha saubhāgyaṃ samare vijayaṃ tathā ..
sarvānkāmām̐stathā vidyāṃ dhanaṃ jīvitameva ca .. 31 ..
1.142.d:
अरोग्यमथ सौभाग्यं समरे विजयं तथा ॥
सर्वान्कामाम्̐स्तथा विद्यां धनं जीवितमेव च ॥ 31 ॥
1.142.m: Freedom from disease, and good fortune, victory in battle, / all desires, knowledge, wealth, and life itself—

1.142.s:
ādityādidineṣveva śrāddhaṃ kurvansadā naraḥ ..
krameṇaitadavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. .. 32 ..
1.142.d:
आदित्यादिदिनेष्वेव श्राद्धं कुर्वन्सदा नरः ॥
क्रमेणैतदवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
1.142.m: a man always performing the śrāddha on the days beginning with Sunday / attains these in order; no doubt should be entertained here:

1.142.s:
svargaṃ hyapatyāni tathā brahmavarcasameva ca ..
raudreṇa karmaṇā siddhiṃ bhuvaṃ puṣṭiṃ tathā śriyam .. 33 ..
1.142.d:
स्वर्गं ह्यपत्यानि तथा ब्रह्मवर्चसमेव च ॥
रौद्रेण कर्मणा सिद्धिं भुवं पुष्टिं तथा श्रियम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.142.m: heaven, offspring, and spiritual lustre from the Vedas, / success through a fierce rite, land, nourishment, and fortune,

1.142.s:
sarvānkāmām̐śca saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ jñāti pradhānatām ..
rūpayuktām̐śca tanayānvāṇijyāddhanasaṃpadam .. 34 ..
1.142.d:
सर्वान्कामाम्̐श्च सौभाग्यं धनं ज्ञाति प्रधानताम् ॥
रूपयुक्ताम्̐श्च तनयान्वाणिज्याद्धनसंपदम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.142.m: all desires, good fortune, wealth, supremacy among kin, / handsome sons, and abundant wealth from trade.

1.142.s:
kanakaṃ suhṛdo rājyaṃ saphalāṃ ca tathā kṛṣim ..
samudrayānāllābhaṃ ca sarvānkāmām̐ntathaiva ca .. 35 ..
1.142.d:
कनकं सुहृदो राज्यं सफलां च तथा कृषिम् ॥
समुद्रयानाल्लाभं च सर्वान्कामाम्̐न्तथैव च ॥ 35 ॥
1.142.m: gold, friends, a kingdom, and fruitful agriculture, / gain from sea voyages, and likewise all desires;

1.142.s:
śraiṣṭhyakāmāṃstathā sarvānbalamārogyameva ca ..
rūpyaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhaṃ gāśca turagām̐ścaiva jīvitam .. 36 ..
1.142.d:
श्रैष्ठ्यकामांस्तथा सर्वान्बलमारोग्यमेव च ॥
रूप्यं द्रव्यं गृहं गाश्च तुरगाम्̐श्चैव जीवितम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.142.m: all desires for pre-eminence, strength, and health, / silver, wealth, a house, cows, horses, and long life.

1.142.s:
kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ kramāttu bhagaṇe naraḥ ..
ekaikasminkramātkurvañchrāddhaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 37 ..
1.142.d:
कृत्तिकादिभरण्यन्तं क्रमात्तु भगणे नरः ॥
एकैकस्मिन्क्रमात्कुर्वञ्छ्राद्धं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.142.m: By performing the śrāddha successively in the circle of asterisms, / beginning with Kṛttikā and ending with Bharaṇī, a man undoubtedly attains [these] one by one.

1.142.s:
striyaḥ surūpāḥ svagṛhe kanyānāṃ ca tathā varān..
sarvānkāmānyaśaścaiva śriyaṃ dyūtajayaṃ kṛṣim .. 38 ..
1.142.d:
स्त्रियः सुरूपाः स्वगृहे कन्यानां च तथा वरान्॥
सर्वान्कामान्यशश्चैव श्रियं द्यूतजयं कृषिम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.142.m: Beautiful women in his house, and suitors for his daughters, / all desires, renown, prosperity, victory in gambling, agriculture,

1.142.s:
vāṇijyaṃ paśavaścaiva vājinaśca tathā sutān ..
suvarṇaraupyasaubhāgyaṃ prāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ kramāt .. 39..
1.142.d:
वाणिज्यं पशवश्चैव वाजिनश्च तथा सुतान् ॥
सुवर्णरौप्यसौभाग्यं प्राप्नोति श्राद्धदः क्रमात् ॥ 39॥
1.142.m: trade, livestock, horses, and sons, / gold, silver, and good fortune—the giver of śrāddha attains [these] in order.

1.142.s:
pratipatprabhṛti hyetadyāvadrājam̐strayodathī ..
caturdaśyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ ye narāḥ śastraghātitāḥ .. 1.142.40 ..
1.142.d:
प्रतिपत्प्रभृति ह्येतद्यावद्राजम्̐स्त्रयोदथी ॥
चतुर्दश्यां तु कर्तव्यं ये नराः शस्त्रघातिताः ॥ 1.142.40 ॥
1.142.m: For this [extends] from the first lunar day up to the thirteenth, O king; / but on the fourteenth it should be performed for men who were slain by weapons.

1.142.s:
śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu kāryaṃ kāmānsamagrām̐llabhate manuṣyaḥ ..
tasmātprayatnena narendra kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu tajjñaiḥ .. 41 .. ..
1.142.d:
श्राद्धं सदा पञ्चदशीषु कार्यं कामान्समग्राम्̐ल्लभते मनुष्यः ॥
तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन नरेन्द्र कार्यं श्राद्धं सदा पञ्चदशीषु तज्ज्ञैः ॥ 41 ॥ ॥
1.142.m: A śrāddha should always be performed on the fifteenth days; a man obtains complete desires. / Therefore, O king, a śrāddha should always be performed on the fifteenth days with effort by those who know the truth.

1.143.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
kasmai śrāddhaṃ na dātavyaṃ kena bhuktaṃ mahāphalam ..
bhavatīha dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.143.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
कस्मै श्राद्धं न दातव्यं केन भुक्तं महाफलम् ॥
भवतीह द्विजश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.143.m: Vajra said: / To whom should a śrāddha not be given, and eaten by whom does it produce great fruit / here [in this world], O best of twice-born? Tell me that as I ask.

1.143.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
anūḍhātanayo rājanyaśca paunarbhavaḥ sutaḥ ..
śūdrāpatirdurācāro vāṇijyāyudhajīvakaḥ .. 2 ..
1.143.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
अनूढातनयो राजन्यश्च पौनर्भवः सुतः ॥
शूद्रापतिर्दुराचारो वाणिज्यायुधजीवकः ॥ 2 ॥
1.143.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The son of an unmarried woman, O king, and a son born of a remarried woman; / the husband of a śūdra woman; one of evil conduct; one who lives by trade or by weapons;

1.143.s:
tathā vārdhuṣiko yaśca śūdrasya ca purohitaḥ ..
parvakārastathā sūcī yasya copapatirgṛhe .. 3 ..
1.143.d:
तथा वार्धुषिको यश्च शूद्रस्य च पुरोहितः ॥
पर्वकारस्तथा सूची यस्य चोपपतिर्गृहे ॥ 3 ॥
1.143.m: and also a usurer, and a priest of a śūdra; / an astrologer who declares festival days; an informant; and one in whose house is a paramour;

1.143.s:
kṛtvā nakṣatranirdeśaṃ yaśca jīvati pārthiva ..
cikitsitena ca tathā yasya vṛttirnareśvara ..4..
1.143.d:
कृत्वा नक्षत्रनिर्देशं यश्च जीवति पार्थिव ॥
चिकित्सितेन च तथा यस्य वृत्तिर्नरेश्वर ॥4॥
1.143.m: one who lives by pointing out asterisms, O ruler of the earth; / and one whose livelihood is by medicine, O lord of men;

1.143.s:
vedavikrayako yaśca vedanindaka eva ca ..
tarkaśāstreṇa dagdhaśca nāstiko dharmavarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
1.143.d:
वेदविक्रयको यश्च वेदनिन्दक एव च ॥
तर्कशास्त्रेण दग्धश्च नास्तिको धर्मवर्जितः ॥ 5 ॥
1.143.m: and one who sells the Veda, and one who reviles the Veda; / one burnt by the science of logic, an atheist, one devoid of dharma;

1.143.s:
pitrā vivadamānaśca yaścaivopanayedbahūn ..
ayājyayājī stenaśca yakṣmī kitava eva ca .. 6 ..
1.143.d:
पित्रा विवदमानश्च यश्चैवोपनयेद्बहून् ॥
अयाज्ययाजी स्तेनश्च यक्ष्मी कितव एव च ॥ 6 ॥
1.143.m: one who quarrels with his father, and one who initiates many [for money]; / one who sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice, a thief, a consumptive, and a gambler;

1.143.s:
śvitrī ca yastathā kāṇo badhiro'ndhaḥ kuṇistathā ..
parapūrvāpatiścaiva grāmapreṣyo nirākṛtiḥ .. 7 ..
1.143.d:
श्वित्री च यस्तथा काणो बधिरोऽन्धः कुणिस्तथा ॥
परपूर्वापतिश्चैव ग्रामप्रेष्यो निराकृतिः ॥ 7 ॥
1.143.m: and one suffering from white leprosy, one who is one-eyed, deaf, blind, or has a withered arm; / the husband of a woman married before, a village servant, one who has neglected Vedic study;

1.143.s:
avakīrṇī kuṇḍagolau kunakhī śyāvadantakaḥ ..
kanyādūṣyabhiśaptaśca mitradhukpiśunastathā .. 8 ..
1.143.d:
अवकीर्णी कुण्डगोलौ कुनखी श्यावदन्तकः ॥
कन्यादूष्यभिशप्तश्च मित्रधुक्पिशुनस्तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.143.m: one who has broken his vow of celibacy, a kuṇḍa and a gola, one with bad nails, one with dark teeth; / one who defiles a maiden, an accused person, one who harms a friend, and a slanderer;

1.143.s:
parivittiḥ parivettā tasya kanyāpradaśca yaḥ ..
yājakaśca tathā tasya somavikrayakastathā..9..
1.143.d:
परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता तस्य कन्याप्रदश्च यः ॥
याजकश्च तथा तस्य सोमविक्रयकस्तथा॥9॥
1.143.m: a younger brother married before his elder, an unmarried elder brother whose younger brother has married, and one who gives a daughter to him; / and his priest, and also a seller of soma;

1.143.s:
kūṭasākṣī ca vāgduṣṭaḥ paradāro vikarmakaḥ ..
tathā daivāpaviddhāgniḥ viruddhajanakastathā .. 1.143.10 ..
1.143.d:
कूटसाक्षी च वाग्दुष्टः परदारो विकर्मकः ॥
तथा दैवापविद्धाग्निः विरुद्धजनकस्तथा ॥ 1.143.10 ॥
1.143.m: a false witness, one foul of speech, an adulterer, one who performs improper deeds; / and one whose sacred fire was abandoned by fate, and one who opposes his father;

1.143.s:
yaśca hīnātiriktāṅgo duścarmā damakastathā ..
yaśca yuktastathā rājanpātakaiścopapātakaiḥ .. 11 ..
1.143.d:
यश्च हीनातिरिक्ताङ्गो दुश्चर्मा दमकस्तथा ॥
यश्च युक्तस्तथा राजन्पातकैश्चोपपातकैः ॥ 11 ॥
1.143.m: and one who has deficient or redundant limbs, one with diseased skin, a trainer [of animals]; / and one who is tainted, O king, with major sins and minor sins;

1.143.s:
dviṣanmitre ubhe caiva prayatnena vivarjayet ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi brāhmaṇānpaṅktipāvanān .. 12 ..
1.143.d:
द्विषन्मित्रे उभे चैव प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्राह्मणान्पङ्क्तिपावनान् ॥ 12 ॥
1.143.m: and both an enemy and a friend one should diligently avoid. / Henceforth I shall declare the brahmins who purify the row.

1.143.s:
brahmadeyānusantānaḥ tapasvī vijitendriyaḥ ..
pārago yajuṣāṃ yaśca sāmavedasya pāragaḥ .. 13..
1.143.d:
ब्रह्मदेयानुसन्तानः तपस्वी विजितेन्द्रियः ॥
पारगो यजुषां यश्च सामवेदस्य पारगः ॥ 13॥
1.143.m: A descendant of one married in the brahma rite, an ascetic, one who has conquered his senses; / one who has mastered the Yajur Veda, and one who has mastered the Sāma Veda;

1.143.s:
ṛgvedapārago yaśca bhṛgvaṅgirasapāragaḥ ..
atharvaśiraso'dhyetā trisuparṇasya pāragaḥ .. 14 ..
1.143.d:
ऋग्वेदपारगो यश्च भृग्वङ्गिरसपारगः ॥
अथर्वशिरसोऽध्येता त्रिसुपर्णस्य पारगः ॥ 14 ॥
1.143.m: one who has mastered the Ṛg Veda, and one who has mastered the Bhṛgvaṅgiras; / a student of the Atharvaśiras, one who has mastered the Trisuparṇa;
one who knows the Triṇāciketa, one who maintains the five fires, one learned in the treatises on dharma; / one who has mastered the Purāṇas, and one learned in the Itihāsas;

1.143.s:
adhīte sottaraṃ yaśca viṣṇudharmamidaṃ śubham ..
vijānāti yathāvacca yaśca vyākaraṇaṃ nṛpa .. 16 ..
1.143.d:
अधीते सोत्तरं यश्च विष्णुधर्ममिदं शुभम् ॥
विजानाति यथावच्च यश्च व्याकरणं नृप ॥ 16 ॥
1.143.m: and one who studies this auspicious dharma of Viṣṇu along with its sequel, / and who understands grammar properly, O king;

1.143.s:
jyotiṣaśca tathā vettā āyurvedasya ca dvijaḥ ..
tābhyāṃ vṛttiṃ na cetkuryādvṛttistābhyāṃ vigarhitā .. 17 ..
1.143.d:
ज्योतिषश्च तथा वेत्ता आयुर्वेदस्य च द्विजः ॥
ताभ्यां वृत्तिं न चेत्कुर्याद्वृत्तिस्ताभ्यां विगर्हिता ॥ 17 ॥
1.143.m: and a twice-born who knows astrology and Āyurveda— / if he does not make a livelihood from them, for a livelihood from them is censured;

1.143.s:
āhitāgniśca yo vidvānsomapaśca dvijottamaḥ ..
guruśuśrūṣaṇaparastīrthapūtaśca yādava ..
gāyatrījāpanirato yogī dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 18 ..
1.143.d:
आहिताग्निश्च यो विद्वान्सोमपश्च द्विजोत्तमः ॥
गुरुशुश्रूषणपरस्तीर्थपूतश्च यादव ॥
गायत्रीजापनिरतो योगी ध्यानपरायणः ॥ 18 ॥
1.143.m: and a wise man who has established the sacred fires, a drinker of soma, an excellent twice-born; / devoted to serving his guru, purified by pilgrimage places, O Yādava; / intent on reciting the Gāyatrī, a yogi, devoted to meditation;

1.143.s:
yasyāpyanante jagatāmadhīśe bhaktiḥ parā yādava devadeve ..
tasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcitpātraṃ triloke puruṣapravīra .. 19 ..
1.143.d:
यस्याप्यनन्ते जगतामधीशे भक्तिः परा यादव देवदेवे ॥
तस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चित्पात्रं त्रिलोके पुरुषप्रवीर ॥ 19 ॥
1.143.m: and he who has supreme devotion to Ananta, the Lord of the worlds, the God of gods, O Yādava— / higher than him there is no other worthy recipient in the three worlds, O hero among men.

1.144.s:
vajra uvāca ..
kasminbahuphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ deśe brāhmaṇapuṅgava ..
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣya bhavānbrahma ivāparaḥ .. 1 ..
1.144.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
कस्मिन्बहुफलं श्राद्धं देशे ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव ॥
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्य भवान्ब्रह्म इवापरः ॥ 1 ॥
1.144.m: Vajra said: / In what place does a śrāddha bear great fruit, O bull among brahmins? / Tell me all this, for you are like another Brahmā.

1.144.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
gayāśīrṣavaṭe śrāddhamakṣayyaṃ parikīrtitam ..
yadarthameṣā carati gāthā loke purātanī .. 2 ..
1.144.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
गयाशीर्षवटे श्राद्धमक्षय्यं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
यदर्थमेषा चरति गाथा लोके पुरातनी ॥ 2 ॥
1.144.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / A śrāddha at the banyan tree of Gayāśīrṣa is proclaimed to be imperishable, / for which purpose this ancient verse is recited in the world:

1.144.s:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet ..
yajeta vāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet .. 3 ..
1.144.d:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोपि गयां व्रजेत् ॥
यजेत वाश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.144.m: 'Many sons are to be desired, in the hope that even one might go to Gayā, / or perform a horse sacrifice, or release a dark blue bull.'

1.144.s:
puṣkareṣvakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayāge naimiṣe tathā ..
vārāṇasyāṃ prabhāse ca kurukṣetre samantataḥ .. 4 ..
1.144.d:
पुष्करेष्वक्षयं श्राद्धं प्रयागे नैमिषे तथा ॥
वाराणस्यां प्रभासे च कुरुक्षेत्रे समन्ततः ॥ 4 ॥
1.144.m: A śrāddha is imperishable at Puṣkara, at Prayāga, and likewise at Naimiṣa, / at Vārāṇasī, at Prabhāsa, and all around Kurukṣetra;

1.144.s:
sannihatyāṃ viśeṣeṇa rāhugraste niśākare ..
(rāhugraste dinakare sannītyāṃ pārthivottama) .. 5 ..
1.144.d:
सन्निहत्यां विशेषेण राहुग्रस्ते निशाकरे ॥
(राहुग्रस्ते दिनकरे सन्नीत्यां पार्थिवोत्तम) ॥ 5 ॥
1.144.m: especially at Sannihati when the moon is seized by Rāhu, / (when the sun is seized by Rāhu at Sannīti, O best of kings).

1.144.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā samāpnoti rājasūyaśataṃ naraḥ ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalama..6..
1.144.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा समाप्नोति राजसूयशतं नरः ॥
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य सम्यगिष्टस्य यत्फलम॥6॥
1.144.m: Having performed a śrāddha, a man attains [the fruit of] a hundred rājasūya sacrifices; / whatever is the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices properly offered,

1.144.s:
snāta eva tadāpnoti kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ sa mānavaḥ..
sarveṣu devalokeṣu kāmacārī virājate..7..
1.144.d:
स्नात एव तदाप्नोति कृत्वा श्राद्धं स मानवः॥
सर्वेषु देवलोकेषु कामचारी विराजते॥7॥
1.144.m: that human being obtains it merely by bathing and having performed a śrāddha. / Moving at will through all the worlds of the gods, he shines,

1.144.s:
padmavarṇena yānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā ..
devarāmāgaṇāḍhyena vīṇāmurajanādinā .. 8..
1.144.d:
पद्मवर्णेन यानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना ॥
देवरामागणाढ्येन वीणामुरजनादिना ॥ 8॥
1.144.m: in a lotus-coloured vehicle adorned with garlands of little bells, / filled with hosts of celestial maidens, resounding with lutes and drums,

1.144.s:
divyaśvetāśvayuktena kāmagena yathāsukham ..
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatkrīḍatyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ .. 9 ..
1.144.d:
दिव्यश्वेताश्वयुक्तेन कामगेन यथासुखम् ॥
आभूतसंप्लवं यावत्क्रीडत्यप्सरसां गणैः ॥ 9 ॥
1.144.m: yoked with divine white horses, moving at will according to his pleasure. / Until the dissolution of all beings, he sports with hosts of apsarases.

1.144.s:
kṛtakṛtyaśca bhavati pitṝṇāmanṛṇastathā ..
śrāddhaṃ tathā pitṝṇāṃ ca nopayujyeta vai punaḥ .. 1.144.10 ..
1.144.d:
कृतकृत्यश्च भवति पितॄणामनृणस्तथा ॥
श्राद्धं तथा पितॄणां च नोपयुज्येत वै पुनः ॥ 1.144.10 ॥
1.144.m: He has accomplished his purpose and is free from debt to his ancestors; / and no further śrāddha is needed for those ancestors.

1.144.s:
yatra kvacana gaṅgāyāṃ śrāddhasyānantyamucyate ..
yamasya bhaginī devī yamunā pāpanāśinī .. 11 ..
1.144.d:
यत्र क्वचन गङ्गायां श्राद्धस्यानन्त्यमुच्यते ॥
यमस्य भगिनी देवी यमुना पापनाशिनी ॥ 11 ॥
1.144.m: Anywhere on the Gaṅgā, the endlessness of śrāddha is declared. / The divine Yamunā, the sister of Yama, destroys sin;

1.144.s:
yatra kvacana tasyāṃ hi śrāddhasyānantyamucyate..
pitṝṇāṃ duhitā rājannarmadā saritāṃ varā .. 12 ..
1.144.d:
यत्र क्वचन तस्यां हि श्राद्धस्यानन्त्यमुच्यते॥
पितॄणां दुहिता राजन्नर्मदा सरितां वरा ॥ 12 ॥
1.144.m: anywhere on her indeed the endlessness of śrāddha is declared. / The daughter of the ancestors, O king, is the Narmadā, the best of rivers;

1.144.s:
tasyāstīre tathānantaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvatra pārthiva ..
akṣayyaṃ ca tathā śrāddhamamarāntikaparvate .. 13 ..
1.144.d:
तस्यास्तीरे तथानन्तं श्राद्धं सर्वत्र पार्थिव ॥
अक्षय्यं च तथा श्राद्धममरान्तिकपर्वते ॥ 13 ॥
1.144.m: on her bank, likewise, a śrāddha is everywhere endless, O ruler of the earth. / And a śrāddha is imperishable on Mount Amarāntika;

1.144.s:
varāhaparvate rājañchrāddhasyānantyamucyate ..
himavānparvataśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraśvaśuro giriḥ .. 14 ..
1.144.d:
वराहपर्वते राजञ्छ्राद्धस्यानन्त्यमुच्यते ॥
हिमवान्पर्वतश्रेष्ठः शङ्करश्वशुरो गिरिः ॥ 14 ॥
1.144.m: on Mount Varāha, O king, the endlessness of śrāddha is declared. / The Himavat is the best of mountains, the mountain that is the father-in-law of Śaṅkara;

1.144.s:
