सभास्थं सान्त्वयामास पौरजानपदं जनम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.156.m:
and having honoured the brahmins with devotion with heaps of various riches,
he comforted the people of the city and country assembled in the court.

1.156.s:
āśvāsya preṣayāmāsa gṛhānyodhajanaṃ tathā ..
janānurāgasaṃyuktastataḥ prabhṛti pārthivaḥ .. 33 ..
1.156.d:
आश्वास्य प्रेषयामास गृहान्योधजनं तथा ॥
जनानुरागसंयुक्तस्ततः प्रभृति पार्थिवः ॥ 33 ॥
1.156.m:
Having cheered the warrior-folk, he dismissed them to their homes.
From then on, the king, endowed with the affection of his people,

1.156.s:
rājaśāstropadeśena pālayāmāsa medinīm ..
reme ca saha rāmābhirgandharvapratimo yuvā .. 34 ..
1.156.d:
राजशास्त्रोपदेशेन पालयामास मेदिनीम् ॥
रेमे च सह रामाभिर्गन्धर्वप्रतिमो युवा ॥ 34 ॥
1.156.m:
protected the earth according to the precepts of royal science,
and, resembling a Gandharva, the youth sported with lovely women.

1.156.s:
sa tu kālena mahatā rājā pañcatvamāgataḥ ..
uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ .. 35 ..
1.156.d:
स तु कालेन महता राजा पञ्चत्वमागतः ॥
उवास सुचिरं कालं पूज्यमानः सुरोत्तमैः ॥ 35 ॥
1.156.m:
Then, after a great length of time, the king met his death
and dwelt for a very long time worshipped by the foremost of gods.

1.156.s:
manvantare hyatīte tu cākṣuṣasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vaivasvate'tha samprāpte budhaputratvamāgataḥ .. 36 ..
1.156.d:
मन्वन्तरे ह्यतीते तु चाक्षुषस्य महात्मनः ॥
वैवस्वतेऽथ सम्प्राप्ते बुधपुत्रत्वमागतः ॥ 36 ॥
1.156.m:
When the manvantara of the great-souled Cākṣuṣa had passed away,
and when the Vaivasvata arrived, he became the son of Budha.

1.156.s:
tatra tasya tu yadrūpaṃ saubhāgyādeva viśrutam ..
saśarīrasya ca tathā svarloke gamanaṃ nṛpa .. 37 ..
1.156.d:
तत्र तस्य तु यद्रूपं सौभाग्यादेव विश्रुतम् ॥
सशरीरस्य च तथा स्वर्लोके गमनं नृप ॥ 37 ॥
1.156.m:
There indeed, his beauty was famed only through good fortune;
and likewise his going in his physical body to the heavenly world, O king.

1.156.s:
svargato'pi sa rājarṣiḥ kṣīṇe vaivasvate'ntare ..
praviśyātipuraṃ viṣṇoścandramaṇḍalamadhyagam .. 38 ..
1.156.d:
स्वर्गतोऽपि स राजर्षिः क्षीणे वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ॥
प्रविश्यातिपुरं विष्णोश्चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.156.m:
Even having gone to heaven, when the Vaivasvata manvantara has expired, that royal seer,
entering the supreme city of Viṣṇu, will dwell within the lunar orb.

1.156.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ karmaṇā yena pārthivaḥ ..
avāpa tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamapi cottamam .. 39 ..
1.156.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कर्मणा येन पार्थिवः ॥
अवाप तादृशं रूपं सौभाग्यमपि चोत्तमम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.156.m:
All this has been told to you, by which deed the king
obtained such a form and also supreme good fortune.

1.156.s:
pūjayanti hariṃ devaṃ sāttvikāstu nirāśiṣaḥ ..
rājasāḥ kāmakāmāśca krūrakāmāśca tāmasāḥ .. 1.156.40 ..
1.156.d:
पूजयन्ति हरिं देवं सात्त्विकास्तु निराशिषः ॥
राजसाः कामकामाश्च क्रूरकामाश्च तामसाः ॥ 1.156.40 ॥
1.156.m:
Those of the sattva nature, free from expectations, worship the god Hari;
those of the rajas nature seek their desires, and those of the tamas nature seek cruel ends.

1.156.s:
hariṃ sampūjya manasā rājasena purūravāḥ ..
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau .. 41 ..
1.156.d:
हरिं सम्पूज्य मनसा राजसेन पुरूरवाः ॥
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् बभौ ॥ 41 ॥
1.156.m:
Purūravas, having worshipped Hari with a mind of rajas,
shone as sole sovereign over the earth with its seven continents and oceans.

1.156.s:
svargaṃ sudurlabhaṃ prāpya sthānaṃ prāpsyati śāśvatam ..
nāsti viṣṇusamo nātho nāsti viṣṇusamā gatiḥ .. 42 ..
1.156.d:
स्वर्गं सुदुर्लभं प्राप्य स्थानं प्राप्स्यति शाश्वतम् ॥
नास्ति विष्णुसमो नाथो नास्ति विष्णुसमा गतिः ॥ 42 ॥
1.156.m:
Having attained heaven, so difficult to reach, he will attain an eternal abode.
There is no protector equal to Viṣṇu, there is no refuge equal to Viṣṇu.

1.156.s:
nāsti viṣṇusamaṃ trāṇaṃ narasyārtasya bheṣajam ..
satkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ devasya cakriṇaḥ .. 43 ..
1.156.d:
नास्ति विष्णुसमं त्राणं नरस्यार्तस्य भेषजम् ॥
सत्कृतं पूजनं येन कृतं देवस्य चक्रिणः ॥ 43 ॥
1.156.m:
There is no protection equal to Viṣṇu, the medicine for afflicted man.
By whomsoever a reverent worship of the discus-bearing god is performed,

1.156.s:
ārātrikaṃ kṛtaṃ tena saṃprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam ..
yena saṃkīrtitaṃ rājanharirityakṣaradvayam .. 44 ..
1.156.d:
आरात्रिकं कृतं तेन संप्राप्तं परमं पदम् ॥
येन संकीर्तितं राजन्हरिरित्यक्षरद्वयम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.156.m:
and the waving of lights has been offered, the supreme abode is attained.
By whomsoever, O king, the two syllables 'Ha-ri' are chanted,

1.156.s:
baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gaganaṃ prati ..
etatte budhaputrasya triṣu janmasu pārthiva ..
caritaṃ sakalaṃ proktaṃ yena sampūjito hariḥ .. 45 ..
1.156.d:
बद्धः परिकरस्तेन मोक्षाय गगनं प्रति ॥
एतत्ते बुधपुत्रस्य त्रिषु जन्मसु पार्थिव ॥
चरितं सकलं प्रोक्तं येन सम्पूजितो हरिः ॥ 45 ॥
1.156.m:
a belt is girded by him for liberation towards the skies.
Thus, O king, the entire account of the son of Budha through three births
has been told to you, by whom Hari was worshipped.

1.156.s:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ puṣṭivivardhanaṃ ca ..
śrotavyametanniyataṃ ca sadbhirākhyānamūrjaskaramṛddhikāmaiḥ .. 46 ..
1.156.d:
धन्यं यशस्यं रिपुनाशनं च सौभाग्यदं पुष्टिविवर्धनं च ॥
श्रोतव्यमेतन्नियतं च सद्भिराख्यानमूर्जस्करमृद्धिकामैः ॥ 46 ॥
1.156.m:
Auspicious, bringing renown, destroying enemies, granting good fortune, and increasing prosperity,
this invigorating narrative must constantly be heard by the virtuous who desire abundance.

1.157.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
dvādaśīṣu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sopavāsena pūjitaḥ ..
rājyapradaḥ syāddharmajña tanme tvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
1.157.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
द्वादशीषु कथं विष्णुः सोपवासेन पूजितः ॥
राज्यप्रदः स्याद्धर्मज्ञ तन्मे त्वं ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.157.m:
Vajra said:
How is Viṣṇu, worshipped with fasting on the twelfth days,
a bestower of kingdom, O knower of dharma? Tell me that in truth.

1.157.s:
paśya rājyasya māhātmyaṃ yatra dharmasakhāvubhau ..
śṛṇu tasya ca dharmasya phalabhāgdhārmiko nṛpaḥ .. 2 ..
1.157.d:
पश्य राज्यस्य माहात्म्यं यत्र धर्मसखावुभौ ॥
शृणु तस्य च धर्मस्य फलभाग्धार्मिको नृपः ॥ 2 ॥
1.157.m:
Behold the majesty of a kingdom, wherein both [the king and his subject] are companions in dharma;
hear, and the righteous king is a sharer in the fruit of that dharma.

1.157.s:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ ..
rājñā saṃrakṣitāḥ sarve śakyā dharmaṃ niṣevitum .. 3 ..
1.157.d:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः ॥
राज्ञा संरक्षिताः सर्वे शक्या धर्मं निषेवितुम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.157.m:
The student of the Veda, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the mendicant—
all these, protected by the king, are able to practice dharma.

1.157.s:
mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa rājā devavapurdharaḥ ..
kṣattriyo'pi sadā pūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām .. 4 ..
1.157.d:
मानुषेण शरीरेण राजा देववपुर्धरः ॥
क्षत्त्रियोऽपि सदा पूज्यो ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.157.m:
Though possessing a human body, the king bears the form of a god;
though a kṣatriya, he is ever worthy of worship by the great-souled brahmins.

1.157.s:
vinā rājyaṃ hi yā lakṣmīḥ paratantrā hi sā matā ..
tasmādrājyaṃ praśaṃsanti tatrājñā na vihanyate .. 9 ..
1.157.d:
विना राज्यं हि या लक्ष्मीः परतन्त्रा हि सा मता ॥
तस्माद्राज्यं प्रशंसन्ति तत्राज्ञा न विहन्यते ॥ 9 ॥
1.157.m:
For royal fortune without a kingdom is considered dependent on another;
therefore they praise kingdom, [for] therein one's command is not thwarted.

1.157.s:
tulyadhātuśarīrāṇāṃ tulyāvayavajīvinām ..
narendrāṇāṃ narairbrahmandevavadbhuvi manyate .. 6 ..
1.157.d:
तुल्यधातुशरीराणां तुल्यावयवजीविनाम् ॥
नरेन्द्राणां नरैर्ब्रह्मन्देववद्भुवि मन्यते ॥ 6 ॥
1.157.m:
Though having bodies of the same elements and living with the same limbs,
rulers of men, O brahmin, are regarded by men on earth like gods.

1.157.s:
rājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ tasmādvaktumarhati me bhavān ..
yāmupoṣya mahadrājyaṃ prāpnuyātsa tu vai dvijaḥ .. 7 ..
1.157.d:
राज्यदां द्वादशीं तस्माद्वक्तुमर्हति मे भवान् ॥
यामुपोष्य महद्राज्यं प्राप्नुयात्स तु वै द्विजः ॥ 7 ॥
1.157.m:
Therefore, you ought to tell me of the twelfth-day rite that grants kingship,
fasting on which, a twice-born may indeed obtain a great kingdom.

1.157.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanrājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ śubhām ..
yāmupoṣya naro loke rājyamāpnotyakaṇṭakam .. 8 ..
1.157.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शृणुष्वावहितो राजन्राज्यदां द्वादशीं शुभाम् ॥
यामुपोष्य नरो लोके राज्यमाप्नोत्यकण्टकम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.157.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Listen attentively, O King, to the auspicious Dvādaśī that grants kingdom, / by fasting on which a man in this world attains a kingdom free from thorns.

1.157.s:
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣe narādhipa ..
daśamyāṃ prayataḥ kṛtvā snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam .. 9 ..
1.157.d:
मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य शुक्लपक्षे नराधिप ॥
दशम्यां प्रयतः कृत्वा स्नानमभ्यङ्गपूर्वकम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.157.m: In the bright fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O ruler of men, / after taking a bath preceded by oil anointment on the tenth lunar day with controlled senses,

1.157.s:
upavāsasya saṃkalpaṃ śvobhūtasya tu kārayet ..
devāgāre kuśāstīrṇāmekavastrottaracchadām ..1.157.1 0..
1.157.d:
उपवासस्य संकल्पं श्वोभूतस्य तु कारयेत् ॥
देवागारे कुशास्तीर्णामेकवस्त्रोत्तरच्छदाम् ॥1.157.1 0॥
1.157.m: he should make the resolution for the fast of the following day. / In a temple, on the ground strewn with kuśa grass and covered with a single cloth,

1.157.s:
adhyāsīta mahīṃ tatra tāṃ rātriṃ prayato nayet ..
dvitīye'hni tataḥ kuryādbahiḥ snānamatandritaḥ .. 11 ..
1.157.d:
अध्यासीत महीं तत्र तां रात्रिं प्रयतो नयेत् ॥
द्वितीयेऽह्नि ततः कुर्याद्बहिः स्नानमतन्द्रितः ॥ 11 ॥
1.157.m: he should lie down and spend that night with self-restraint. / Then, on the second day, unflagging, he should bathe in open water.

1.157.s:
pūjanaṃ devadevasya sarvaṃ śuklena kārayet ..
karpūraṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ mallikā śvetayūthikā ..12..
1.157.d:
पूजनं देवदेवस्य सर्वं शुक्लेन कारयेत् ॥
कर्पूरं चन्दनं देयं मल्लिका श्वेतयूथिका ॥12॥
1.157.m: He should perform the entire worship of the God of gods with white materials: / camphor and sandalwood should be offered, [along with] jasmine and white jasmine,

1.157.s:
jātyā ca śuklā rājendra dhūpe karpūrameva ca ..
ghṛtena dīpā dātavyā śuklavartisamanvitā . .. 13 ..
1.157.d:
जात्या च शुक्ला राजेन्द्र धूपे कर्पूरमेव च ॥
घृतेन दीपा दातव्या शुक्लवर्तिसमन्विता ॥। 13 ॥
1.157.m: and white Spanish jasmine, O best of kings; and camphor in the incense. / Lamps provided with white wicks should be offered with clarified butter.

1.157.s:
ghṛtaudanaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ikṣumikṣuvikārāṃśca devadeve nivedayet .. 14 ..
1.157.d:
घृतौदनं दधि क्षीरं परमान्नं तथैव च ॥
इक्षुमिक्षुविकारांश्च देवदेवे निवेदयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.157.m: Rice cooked with clarified butter, curd, milk, and sweet rice-milk, / as well as sugarcane and sugarcane products, he should present to the God of gods.

1.157.s:
kālodbhavaṃ mūlaphalaṃ varṇaṃ tatra na cintayeta ..
yathālābhena taddeyaṃ śuklaṃ cetsyādviśeṣataḥ .. 15 ..
1.157.d:
कालोद्भवं मूलफलं वर्णं तत्र न चिन्तयेत ॥
यथालाभेन तद्देयं शुक्लं चेत्स्याद्विशेषतः ॥ 15 ॥
1.157.m: Seasonal roots and fruits—he need not consider their colour; / whatever is obtained should be offered, but if it is white, it is especially [laudable].

1.157.s:
havanaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ paramānnena pārthiva ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paraṃ ityevaṃ homamantro vidhīyate .. 16 ..
1.157.d:
हवनं च ततः कार्यं परमान्नेन पार्थिव ॥
तद्विष्णोः परं इत्येवं होममन्त्रो विधीयते ॥ 16 ॥
1.157.m: Then an oblation into the fire should be made with sweet rice-milk, O king; / 'Tad viṣṇoḥ paramam' is prescribed as the mantra for the fire offering.

1.157.s:
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdrasya vidhīyate ..
tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā sampūjya ca dvijān .. 17 ..
1.157.d:
द्वादशाक्षरकं मन्त्रं स्त्रीशूद्रस्य विधीयते ॥
ततोऽग्निहवनं कृत्वा शक्त्या सम्पूज्य च द्विजान् ॥ 17 ॥
1.157.m: The twelve-syllable mantra is prescribed for women and śūdras. / Having then made the offering into the fire and worshipped the twice-born according to one's capacity,

1.157.s:
sitaraṃgena kartavyā bhūmiśobhā surālaye ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gīta nṛtyaṃ ca pārthiva .. 18 ..
1.157.d:
सितरंगेन कर्तव्या भूमिशोभा सुरालये ॥
रात्रौ जागरणं कार्यं गीत नृत्यं च पार्थिव ॥ 18 ॥
1.157.m: decoration of the floor should be made in the temple with white colour. / A vigil should be kept at night with song and dance, O king,

1.157.s:
karmaṇā caiva devasya kartavyaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ..
dvādaśyāṃ vidhinā'nena bhūyaḥ pūjyo janārdanaḥ ... .. 19 ..
1.157.d:
कर्मणा चैव देवस्य कर्तव्यं श्रवणं तथा ॥
द्वादश्यां विधिनाऽनेन भूयः पूज्यो जनार्दनः ॥॥। 19 ॥
1.157.m: and listening [to stories] of the deeds of the god should be performed. / On the twelfth day, according to this rule, Janārdana should be worshipped again.

1.157.s:
rājaliṅgaṃ pradātavyamekaṃ viprāya dakṣiṇā ..
tatastu paścādbhoktavyaṃ haviṣyaṃ pārthivottama ..1.157.20..
1.157.d:
राजलिङ्गं प्रदातव्यमेकं विप्राय दक्षिणा ॥
ततस्तु पश्चाद्भोक्तव्यं हविष्यं पार्थिवोत्तम ॥1.157.20॥
1.157.m: A single royal emblem should be given to a brahmin as the sacrificial fee. / Then, afterwards, haviṣya food should be eaten, O best of kings.

1.157.s:
ekādaśī yathā madhye snānayorantare nṛpa ..
kaṣṭaṃ maunaṃ tu kartavyaṃ japyaṃ kāryaṃ tu mānasam .. 21 ..
1.157.d:
एकादशी यथा मध्ये स्नानयोरन्तरे नृप ॥
कष्टं मौनं तु कर्तव्यं जप्यं कार्यं तु मानसम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.157.m: On the eleventh day falling in the middle between the two baths, O king, / strict silence must be observed, and mental recitation performed.

1.157.s:
dvādaśīṣveva śuklāsu sarvāsvevāviśeṣataḥ ..
vidhistavāyaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsveva ca kārayet .. 22 ..
1.157.d:
द्वादशीष्वेव शुक्लासु सर्वास्वेवाविशेषतः ॥
विधिस्तवायं निर्दिष्टः कृष्णास्वेव च कारयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.157.m: On all the bright Dvādaśīs without distinction, / this rule is prescribed for you; and he should also perform it on the dark ones.

1.157.s:
viśeṣaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
raktavarṇena kartavyā devapūjā yathāvidhi .. 23 ..
1.157.d:
विशेषं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
रक्तवर्णेन कर्तव्या देवपूजा यथाविधि ॥ 23 ॥
1.157.m: I will tell you the distinctive feature; hear it as I speak: / worship of the god should be performed according to rule with red colour.

1.157.s:
raktaṃ ca deyaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpagandhānulepanam ..
tilatailena dīpāśca mahārañjanarañjitāḥ .. 24 ..
1.157.d:
रक्तं च देयं नैवेद्यं पुष्पगन्धानुलेपनम् ॥
तिलतैलेन दीपाश्च महारञ्जनरञ्जिताः ॥ 24 ॥
1.157.m: Red food offering should be given, as well as flowers, perfumes, and ointments; / and lamps with sesame oil dyed with safflower.

1.157.s:
dīpeṣu vartayo deyā homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ ..
bhūmiśobhā ca kartavyā raktairbhūpālavarṇakaiḥ .. 25 ..
1.157.d:
दीपेषु वर्तयो देया होमः कार्यस्तथा तिलैः ॥
भूमिशोभा च कर्तव्या रक्तैर्भूपालवर्णकैः ॥ 25 ॥
1.157.m: In the lamps, wicks should be supplied, and an oblation should be made with sesame seeds; / and decoration of the floor should be made with red pigments, O protector of the earth.

1.157.s:
anena vidhinā kṛtvā rājansaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ ..
kārtikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet .. 26 ..
1.157.d:
अनेन विधिना कृत्वा राजन्संवत्सरं ततः ॥
कार्तिक्यां समतीतायां कृष्णा या द्वादशी भवेत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.157.m: Having performed it according to this rule for a year, O King, / on the dark Dvādaśī that comes when Kārttikā has passed,

1.157.s:
vratāvasāne tasyāṃ tu mahāvartiṃ tu dāpayet ..
vāsasā ca samagreṇa tulayā ca ghṛtasya vai .. 27 ..
1.157.d:
व्रतावसाने तस्यां तु महावर्तिं तु दापयेत् ॥
वाससा च समग्रेण तुलया च घृतस्य वै ॥ 27 ॥
1.157.m: at the conclusion of the vow on that [day], he should present a great wick, / along with a whole piece of cloth and a tulā of clarified butter.

1.157.s:
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā dhenuḥ kāṃsyopadohanā ..
hemaśṛṅgrī raupyakhurā muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitā .. 28 ..
1.157.d:
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्या धेनुः कांस्योपदोहना ॥
हेमशृङ्ग्री रौप्यखुरा मुक्तालांगूलभूषिता ॥ 28 ॥
1.157.m: A cow equipped with a bronze milking vessel should be given to a brahmin, / with gold-tipped horns, silver hooves, and a tail adorned with pearls,

1.157.s:
vastrottarīyā dātavyā śaktyā draviṇasaṃyutā ..
saṃvatsareṇa rājā syānnaraḥ parvatagahvare .. 29 ..
1.157.d:
वस्त्रोत्तरीया दातव्या शक्त्या द्रविणसंयुता ॥
संवत्सरेण राजा स्यान्नरः पर्वतगह्वरे ॥ 29 ॥
1.157.m: clothed with an upper garment, and accompanied by wealth according to capacity. / After one year, a man would become a king in a mountain glen;

1.157.s:
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ pūrṇairjāyate saphalaṃ tataḥ ..
tathā dvādaśabhiḥ pūrṇe rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ .. 1.157.30 ..
1.157.d:
त्रिभिः संवत्सरैः पूर्णैर्जायते सफलं ततः ॥
तथा द्वादशभिः पूर्णे राजा भवति पार्थिवः ॥ 1.157.30 ॥
1.157.m: when three full years have elapsed, it becomes fruitful thereafter; / and when twelve years are complete, he becomes an earthly king.

1.157.s:
rājyapradā te'bhihitā mayaiṣā sudvādaśī pāpaharā variṣṭhā ..
upoṣya yāṃ bhūmitale narendro bhavatyajeyaśca raṇe'risaṃghaiḥ .. 31 ..
1.157.d:
राज्यप्रदा तेऽभिहिता मयैषा सुद्वादशी पापहरा वरिष्ठा ॥
उपोष्य यां भूमितले नरेन्द्रो भवत्यजेयश्च रणेऽरिसंघैः ॥ 31 ॥
1.157.m: This excellent, sin-destroying, supreme Dvādaśī that grants kingdom has been related to you by me, / by fasting on which a king on earth becomes invincible in battle against hosts of enemies.

1.158.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣājjanādhipa ..
āra'bhyābhyarcayeddevaṃ dvādaśīṣu sadaiva tu .. 1 ..
1.158.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य शुक्लपक्षाज्जनाधिप ॥
आरऽभ्याभ्यर्चयेद्देवं द्वादशीषु सदैव तु ॥ 1 ॥
1.158.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Beginning from the bright fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O ruler of people, / one should worship the god always on the Dvādaśīs,

1.158.s:
pakṣayorubhayornityaṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
phalaiḥ puṣpairyathākāmaṃ naivedyairhomakarmaṇā .. 2 ..
1.158.d:
पक्षयोरुभयोर्नित्यं सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
फलैः पुष्पैर्यथाकामं नैवेद्यैर्होमकर्मणा ॥ 2 ॥
1.158.m: constantly in both fortnights, fasting and with senses subdued, / with fruits, flowers, offerings according to desire, and the rite of fire offering,

1.158.s:
pūjane brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śaktyā dānaṃ ca pārthiva ..
abhīṣṭanāmajapyena pūrṇātsaṃvansarānnaraḥ .. 3 ..
1.158.d:
पूजने ब्राह्मणानां च शक्त्या दानं च पार्थिव ॥
अभीष्टनामजप्येन पूर्णात्संवन्सरान्नरः ॥ 3 ॥
1.158.m: and with worship of brahmins and gifts according to one's capacity, O king. / By reciting the beloved name, after a full year, a man

1.158.s:
tadevāpnoti rājendra yatra gatvā na śocati ..
akāmāḥ sāttvikā devaṃ pūjayanti janārdanam .. 4 ..
1.158.d:
तदेवाप्नोति राजेन्द्र यत्र गत्वा न शोचति ॥
अकामाः सात्त्विका देवं पूजयन्ति जनार्दनम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.158.m: attains that state going to which he grieves no more, O best of kings. / Desireless persons endowed with sattva worship the god Janārdana;

1.158.s:
tasmādakāmena narendracanda saṃpūjanīyo bhuvanasya goptā ..
tyaktvā vaṇijyaṃ naradeva loke deveśvaro viṣṇurupāsanīyaḥ .. 5 ..
1.158.d:
तस्मादकामेन नरेन्द्रचन्द संपूजनीयो भुवनस्य गोप्ता ॥
त्यक्त्वा वणिज्यं नरदेव लोके देवेश्वरो विष्णुरुपासनीयः ॥ 5 ॥
1.158.m: therefore, O moon among kings, the protector of the world is to be worshipped without desire. / Giving up all commerce in this world, O ruler of men, the lord of gods, Viṣṇu, is to be revered.
